Join us for sunset weddings every day, and groove to our daily music program featuring a unique sound system —. Come recharge and find your vibe with us!

places.desc: A camp of old and new friends. We believe that through evolution, we can create a revolution. We reserve the right to change, to be agents of change and to commit to the Burning Man principles each time we return after our revolution around the sun. We offer food, beverages, healing through Gamma Breath Work, opportunities to communicate with anyone and fun through dance. West Coast Swing and Mart

places.name: Magic Lantern Society
places.desc:
The Magic Lantern is a wandering inn, located at the end of all worlds. Sumptuously-appointed with antiques, curiosities, games, and mysterious old books, we are a space created for deeper human connection, and a warm and inviting sanctuary for the weary and curious traveller.

Our centerpiece is our unique Trading Booth, where stories and secrets are the only accepted currency. Anyone can step up

places.name: Studio and Spa
places.desc: Come to BRC Studio and Spa to not only to receive a massage or have your sensual, erotic or daring fine-art photo taken, but join one of our workshops and take some new skill back to the default word. Either way, walk away with a unique photo print, or a new skill, or at least relaxed!

places.name: Xpat Alien
places.desc:
Xpat Alien has searched far and wide, through many galaxies, to find a new place to rest our travel weary heads. Earth fits the bill and we have decided to stay.
We bring with us the Crop Circle Cantina, complete with 80' of circular shade, phenomenal DJs spinning epic tunes, a bar top with stripper poles for dancing shenanigans, six 3-butt benches to relax on, Colorado brewed craft beer and root

places.name: Hakuna Matata
places.desc:
Building art objects and art cars to light up the Playa Nocturnal Kaleidoscope!
Promoting mindful and safe cruising.
 SLOW DOWN!!!
Leave No Trace

places.name: Servants of the Secret Fire
places.desc: Been bringing dazzling LED and fire art to playa while hosting fire spinning jams and flow workshops since 2015. Come check out our library, dance to our DJ sets, or snuggle into the cuddle puddle beneath a glowing canopy of >14000 LEDs - look for the burgundy/red/orange/yellow dome!

places.name: Bone Voyage
places.desc: Welcome to the official backstage hub for the Bone Voyage mutant vehicle! While our vessel is out cruising the dust, our support camp serves as the critical base to refuel and keep the gears turning. We don't host public events in camp, as our gift to Black Rock City is entirely mobile and out on the open playa. However, if you spot our Mammoth Skull Flags or our Bony Bus, give us a wave...we're p

places.name: Hello, Brooklyn
places.desc: Hello Brooklyn is a vibrant and eclectic camp where urban cool meets whimsical creativity. Our Playa neighborhood combines the charm of Brooklyn with the playful flair of a Florida Panhandle trailer park. With radical inclusion, spontaneity, and community spirit, we create a welcoming camp filled with connection, creativity, and endless surprises.

places.name: Wetspot
places.desc: Established in 2010 and based in Reno, NV, Wetspot is a playa favorite saloon for daytime fun and libations. We invite you to come kick in our doors and let us fill your cup with an ice-cold draft beer or our legendary Skip-and-Go Naked cocktail. Feeling like your burn needs a little more, burn? We've got you covered with a shot of our spicy tequila. You just might end up on the Wall of Flame! Dri

places.name: Sunrise Tavern
places.desc: Come for the bacon, stay for the sunrise. You gnome you'll like ;)

places.name: Star Jelly
places.hometown: San Francisco, San Diego, Park City
places.desc:
A loosely knit collection of individuals operating as a singular organism. Traveling space and time to learn and share with you all at Burning Man. Come by to enjoy our wonderlawn oasis and traverse the sparkly gates to the new you. Or enjoy some general shenanigans in our Jelly Dome. We'll also be giving out Gold Stars, so come by to share your tales of why you deserve a Gold Star!!! 
Fun for all

places.name: Pickleback Oasis
places.desc: Take a break from the hot sun and stop in for a cold Pickleback. Relax and meet new friends under our shade structure.

places.name: Reno Housewives
places.desc: Costuming BRC since 1998. Looking for the perfect outfit for that party? ASK US -- From frumpy to fabulous, we have you covered.

places.name: VW Bus Camp
places.desc: You are heartily invited to camp and participate with VW Bus Camp for Axis Mundi arriving on the Playa in an old VW Bus or other unique camper. VW Bus Camp is a wonderful and enduring Burning Man theme camp which has been placed and participated on the Playa every Burn since 1998. First, make sure to change out your leaky fuel lines, check your tires, carry a fire extinguisher and pack lots and lo

places.name: Glorious Gilded Alchemy
places.desc: Back for more gloriously gilded shenanigans. IYKYK.

places.name: Embers
places.desc: Our Desert Oasis Bar and Lounge offers craft cocktails alongside our popular self-postcard station, where participants write messages to their future selves that we mail before ticket sales as reminders of playa magic. Join us for daily morning yoga sessions, smutty poetry readings, and UV paint dance parties under our powerful blacklight system. Stop by our Playa Confessional booth to record your

places.name: Blood & Sugar
places.desc: A mildly chaotic clubhouse dedicated to the strange art of keeping humans functioning with a little help from treats, movement, and friends. Stop by for Bloody Mary mornings, gummy bears, yoga, and conversations that range from heartfelt to weird to unhinged. This space celebrates resilience, curiosity, and mutual support. Wander in and help us keep things balanced.

places.name: Kinky Pizza
places.desc: Hot slices, Hot flogging, and Hot fire. It's only kinky the first time...

places.name: Dusty Beavers
places.desc: We are the Dusty Beavers. We are a camp at Burning Man. We are from Québec, Canada and France. We bring love, joy and maple goodies to Burning Man!

places.name: Pinhole Project
places.desc: Come create large format pinhole photography to capture art installations and the community in the desert! We have built a darkroom every burn since 1999. We host art-making workshops every morning. We take the workshop on an art tour using old-school pinhole cameras loaded with photographic paper. This allows participants to slow down, observe their surroundings more closely, and truly immerse th

places.name: Endstation
places.desc: Camp Endstation is your last stop before nowhere. Grab a ticket from our dispenser, find a seat, and see what happens. Some days it's a conversation workshop with strangers, other days a tarot reading you didn't plan on. When night falls, the Disorient Express takes over with beats, incense, and tea. Or catch the Loco Motive for a sunrise party before the heat hits. Between events, the tent is ope

places.name: Atomic Octopus
places.desc: A friendly neighborhood dive. Pay no attention to the 30 foot steampunk atomic octopus at the back of the shade structure. Part of 404: Village Not Found.

places.name: Ashram Galactica
places.desc:
The Grand Hotel | Your Home Away From Home Away From Home 

Located Directly Above the Center of the Earth

places.name: Honey Pot Tea House
places.desc:
Come sit by our fire, enjoy a cup of tea, and enjoy a side of Burning Man that is connective, whimsical, and grounding. 
Sunset-sunrise tea service. Cozy fire pit. Open mic. Daily workshops.

places.name: I Taste Purple
places.desc:
Step into a world where a psychedelic dream meets a desert carnival. Look for our kaleidoscope of purples and our signature lips and tongue logo?we're a vibrant, welcoming oasis on the playa.

At our camp, creativity knows no bounds. Join us for crafting, contests, parties, our one-of-a-kind "triathlon," advice of all kinds, and other surprises we dream up each year. Whether you stop by for an act

places.name: Apokalyptika
places.desc: We are proud to be an eco conscious kamp that strives to re-envision waste materials into art. Come chill out with us and have a beverage in our post Apokalpytikally themed sunset bar and 24 hr lounge, or play with our eclectic collection of installations and games.

places.name: Bad Asstronauts
places.desc: The Bad Asstronauts are an Earth-based collective with stations in Denver and San Francisco. We will take care of all your musical and libation needs. Our DJs will blow your mind with electrifying beats on our upgraded sound system to bring you an incredible new audio and visual experience. Quench your thirst with our extraordinary elixirs crafted by our skilled mixologists at the Moontang Bar. St

places.name: Camp Come Find Us CCFU
places.desc: Here at Camp Come Find Us (CCFU) we are a camp that is about finding yourself and exploring who you are at Burning Man. Every journey is individual and unique. Come flow with us and find your journey! We will create a laid-back and spontaneous atmosphere, and our offerings will be inspiring and fulfilling. We endeavor to create a strong community among our fellow Burners. Come find us and find you

places.name: Kamp Kit
places.desc: We specialize only in infused liquor shots, infusing all the flavors ourselves. Some are delicious. Some are too hot to handle. Some are pretty gross. No mixers, no chasers! If you're not drinking, or done drinking, you can contribute to the Playa Name Archive or participate in our open mic.

places.name: Teddies
places.desc: Themed parties, food, bar & tunes all week. Cuddle with Bears & more in the Teddy dome, open 24/7

places.name: Cognitive Research Institute
places.desc:
Would you like a quick memory screening? We can help you make sure you'll actually remember this week.

The Cognitive Research Institute has deployed a desert station to conduct daily field studies on human memory from a fully shaded research station staffed by clipboard-wielding statisticians in lab coats. 

Drop in during the week for a cognitive assessment and maybe a brain massage or two. Subm

places.name: Some Camp!
places.desc:
It's a food bank AND a cinema! Tell us your tale of woe, replace your lost food. Vegan and keto available while supplies last. Bring us your extras (e.g. water, gear, no perishables) for redistribution

Grab some popcorn and stay for a movie after the sun goes down. Most to all selections subtitled/silent. We will be providing hot ramen & drinks after the burn

places.name: Shenanigans
places.desc: ICE COLD face masks! Find us when the sun is high and the heat is excessive every day. We will welcome you into our comfy chill space and put a cold mask straight from our ice packed cooler on your face. While the moisturizing ingredients soak into your skin, you're welcome to kick back and enjoy the occasional water spritz, fanning and cup of iced tea.

places.name: Stoop City
places.desc: Stoop City captures the magic of a fever dream spent wandering the streets of Black Rock City. Come share a secret on our cozy stoops with a new friend, savor a steaming slurp of spicy ramen, or grab a last-minute bandaid from our Asian-inspired bao-dega. This might just be the late night corner bodega you never knew you needed.

places.name: Parliament Art Crew
places.desc: We are an Art Support Camp dedicated to bringing large-scale, immersive installations to life for the delight and inspiration of our community. Over the years, we've proudly supported projects such as COQUÍ, Feed Your Head (Man Base), Atabey's Treasure, MÚCARO, Got Framed, and Pitirre - each one creating meaningful, shared experiences on the playa.

places.name: Cereal Thrillers
places.desc: Breakfast cereal bar where we serve that sugary cereal your Mom didn't let you have as a kid

places.name: Camp Orange
places.desc: Our 16-foot tall banana stand will once again tower erect over the Playa a shining, lighted beacon for all citizens of BRC in search of a place to rest their weary, dusty bananas! Join us for chocolate covered frozen bananas, fruity frozen drinks, silly dance parties, fun and educational sessions inside our cozy dome, a hang in the Largest Known Hammock, or just to chill out and have a good time.

places.name: Cosplay Central
places.desc:
The most awesome Cosplay/Larping experience on earth! 
Come and play in our Barbie/Ken and Burner girl boxes - you will dance like crazy.
Come by and get involved in some fun activities in the Cosplay world - we have costumes and props.
AND For sexy and adventurous couples- We have a Barbie theme and naturally Ken being a dickless doll will be fitted with a male chastity cage and Barbie will hold

places.name: Camp Home
places.desc: Just your friendly neighbors next door. We are here to provide creature comforts ? cold booze, hot tea, mist and buffer massages. Whether it be a piping hot midnight cup of custom blended tea, or a citrusy boozy creation while you briefly escape that blazing playa sunshine, we are here for you. We will keep you cozy with the comforts of home. Let's get weird and stay magical.

places.name: The Dusty Nuts Tavern
places.desc: Escape the constant wub wub for something a little different, along with dusty drinks from dusty people.

places.name: ta-keel-ya or ta-heal-ya
places.desc: A glowing pink disco dome invites passersby to pause and choose their own adventure! Will it be a tequila shot or a fiery wellness shot packed with ingredients like ginger and turmeric. Campmates host this simple but spirited ritual throughout the week, creating a space for laughter, conversation, and unexpected connection. Come spin through, reset your energy, and share a quick moment with fellow

places.name: Slow the Fuck Down
places.desc: Art Department camp

places.name: Camp Ply Curious
places.desc: A fun loving semi eccentric group inviting all to experience the unknown. Be loving. Be musical. Be creative. And above all.....be curious!

places.name: Yabba Dabba Do Me
places.desc: Celebrating 30 years on the playa, the return of Yabba Dabba Do Me, a trampoline suspended from a giant net of bungee cords. Do you think you're a stable person? Then come and enter our "Last Burner Standing" contests. They happen periodically during the week. Every action has a reaction. Every motion has an emotion.

places.name: WHOMP WAGON
places.desc: Whomp Wagon Art Car

places.name: Hiburnia
places.desc: Serving delicious honey, Agave & Clove, infused hot Teas at sunrise and sunset every day. Temple Builders Drink for Free

places.name: PhoCureBurn
places.desc: PhoCureBurn is a Vietnamese-inspired café serving comfort food to the citizens of Black Rock City. We believe food has the power to bring people together and foster a sense of community. Our goal is to create a welcoming space where burners can connect, share stories, and form lasting memories—whether over an iced (!!) coffee or a steaming bowl of pho.

places.name: Pandora's Lounge & Fix-it Shoppe
places.desc:
Our camp keeps our fellow Burners biking: our repair shop offers education, tools and parts, for bike repair. Actually we'll help you repair just about anything, but bikes are our specialty. 
Bike repair is our specialty, we will teach you to do your repair. We are open 24 hrs a day with a self service shop area with tools.

places.name: Maybe You Should Talk To Someone
places.desc: Our camp provides on-playa counseling services, offering burners a space to process emotions, navigate conflicts, and reconnect with their experience in a meaningful way. In addition to one-on-one support, we create opportunities for self-guided reflection at out Zen Tent where you can journal, create art, and enjoy quiet contemplation. By blending therapeutic support with opportunities for intros

places.name: Skinny Kitty Teahouse
places.desc: The best big, fat, kitty-loving teahouse on the playa. Come get some shade, couches and tea, tea, tea 24/7. If you come at the right time you might catch a performance, a wandering piano player tickling the keys, some aerialists, fire spinners or just some fabulous conversation at the tea bar. (Also dead things)

places.name: Galactic Cruzaders
places.desc:
A JOURNEY OF TIME AND SPACE 
Galactic Cruzaders - the true international camp bringing in folks from all over the world. Stop by for Wednesday Night cocktails in formal attire. Sit your ass down and get warm around the camp fire on every night. And stop by and listen to what our DJ's are spining, or join in with the live band when they play.

places.name: Mudskippers
places.desc:
The Home of Pop in the Playa, we are a radically-inclusive, diverse and expressive tight-knit group of lovers from all over the globe.
We're a worldwide network of friends and a family. We work and play together to make the burn more fun and give bigger to those that come to our theme camp. 

Come enjoy our Pop Gym, our amazing dance parties, fun workshops, or just come chill out with us!

places.name: Mechanical Garden
places.desc:
From Wednesday to Saturday afternoons, we share iced mung bean and osmanthus sweet soup with anyone passing by, a traditional Chinese summer dessert meant to cool people down in the desert heat.

Red silk and playful mechanical flowers create a small garden space where people can wander, rest, and explore.

We also take casual portraits and sometimes gift Polaroid photos so visitors can leave with

places.name: Yummy RUMInations
places.desc: Come taste anything real or imagined at the Yum Cart! Playfully-mindful camp uniting burners through laughter, curiosity, and consciousness. Daily experiments in vulnerability, intimacy, self-discovery, and storytelling.

places.name: Only mEmbers
places.desc: "Only mEmbers" bar (21 and over). Only VIPs with proof of membership are permitted. Absolutely no exceptions.

places.name: Children of Chaos
places.desc: Children of Chaos, established in 2000, is returning to the playa! Join our Gold Parade, have your fortune told, stop by our conversation bar and have a drink and a chat! Our campers hail from Reno, Portland, Seattle, San Francisco, Denver, and Houston.

places.name: Interaction Café
places.desc: We create a space where servers get to create their ideal burning man experience by choosing interactions offered to guests who come by, and guests choose whichever of their offerings tickles their fancy. places.name: You Light Up My Ride
places.desc: Disappointed by a poorly lit bike last night on the playa? Never fear! You Light Up My Ride is here to help and inspire you to fabulously light up your rig! Come visit us to get your bike better lit up and stay for a while and share a deep laugh or two.

places.name: Jelly Dance
places.desc: DANCE in our lighted "Psychedelic JELLY-fish Forest" which responds to your touch and enjoy live music from the house band or DJ sets late afternoon/evenings. Join us for band "jam-a-longs", midnight acoustic "Jelly Jams" in the Jelly Forest , "Dust Street Hockey", or very small cocktails at our "Mini-Bar".

places.name: Camp Nope
places.desc: Visit Area 58, an intergalactic and interdimensional roadside attraction constructed from the wreckage of a time-bending rocket. Step inside and get transported. Find the hidden doorway to another dimension - but it only opens sometimes.

places.name: Spec-Taters
places.desc: And amidst this sea of humanity, there are potatoes. Yes, potatoes. Perhaps an unexpected sight in the midst of such a surreal landscape, but therein lies the magic of Burning Man. These humble tubers, often overlooked in daily life, take on new significance here. They're not just food; they're symbols of sustenance, resilience, and community.

places.name: Totally 80s Disco Aerobic Inferno
places.desc:
Welcome to your one-stop shop for fitness on the playa!

Our camp will be offering a variety of fun and interesting classes throughout the week at different times. So whether you’re a morning, midday, or evening fitness person, we’ve got you.

We’ll have Pilates, dance classes, themed workouts, and plenty of opportunities to move your body. Come by, shake some ass, and leave feeling good.

W

places.name: Camp Emergency
places.desc: A Burning Man camp that embodies the ethos of self-expression, communal living, and radical self-reliance. The camp is a vibrant and inclusive community that fosters creativity and encourages its members to embrace their unique identities. The camp's central gathering space provides an area for participants to connect, relax, and engage in creative pursuits. From sunrise yoga sessions to late-nigh

places.name: Sunset Lounge
places.desc:
You know us and you love us.
Up to our usual shenanigans .. Come find us!

places.name: Camp Shutterbuggy
places.desc: Your neighborhood interactive art exhibit with music and drinks each night from 8pm to 12am. We have not one, but TWO of the world's coolest dance poles. Stop by for a spin!

places.desc:
At Birthday Camp, every day is a reason to celebrate. Throughout the week we host playful birthday-themed experiences for anyone passing by...wish-making, card writing, surprise celebrations, and spontaneous moments of joy.

Whether it's your actual birthday or you just want to feel seen and celebrated, our camp is a welcoming place to stop, connect, and share a little happiness. Because on the pl

places.name: Misfits Menagerie

places.name: The Lost Penguins
places.desc:
We have been a hospitality camp on playa since 2001. We are returning this year to bring you our amazing brain-freezing snow cones, and sizzling hot entertainment! Stop by and take shelter from the hot sun, or sit out a dust storm, in our welcoming 40' x 80' shaded lounge. You can relax on our comfy couches, while you enjoy your snow cone or cold beverage from the bar. 

We have live and DJ music,

places.name: Rootpile
places.desc: An established Theme Camp at Burning Man whose mission is to bring live Bluegrass music, Bluegrass musical instrument instruction, and Southern food and culture to the burns that we attend. We offer live pro-Bluegrass music most nights of Burn week. We are open to new members who embrace our mission and culture.

places.name: Wild Child
places.desc:
Run away and join our circus community, hosted by world-class circus artists, where each day is filled with workshops designed to ignite your passion for movement and performance.

Explore the world of Aerial hoop, pole dance, partner acrobatics, fire dancing & flow props, parkour, flips and more.

Whether you're a seasoned performer or a curious beginner, our inclusive community welcomes all skil

places.name: Camp NOT a Cult!
places.desc: Camp Not a Cult provides an alcohol-free, sobriety-supportive space for new and experienced burners which is light-hearted, sarcastically and not culty. We believe that by removing alcohol from our lives we have unlocked a way to live more authentically, feel better, and have more FUN every single day. And that doesn't make us boring. You still find us howling at the moon, wild-eyed and sometimes

places.name: No Drama Camp
places.desc: We are all inclusive Camp that provides the Citizens of Black Rock City with a fun and interesting place to stop by for a Drink at the No Drama Bar. We host many daily events under our large shade structure. Nightly DJ's play music for those stopping by on their way around the Playa. Enjoy our fun oversized Bar Games, while you sip some of the best drinks to be found. There is always something hap

places.name: Gravity
places.desc: Camp Gravity sets sail to the heart of the sea through art installations, activities, and workshops. We make our space to be fun and engaging as well as an amazing place to dance with top notch music! Visit us!

places.name: Camp Peace of Ass
places.desc: Povides the "professional installation" of lusciously, unique, "Peace of Ass" bike seat covers, bringing "Peace to the Playa, One Dusty Bottom at a Time." We continue to service the lovely citizens of Black Rock City who make their way to our inviting camp. We encourage our customers, with humor, to check out the Wall of Mirrors, and write on our annual poster. We also offer an "Ask the Expert" ad

places.name: Insomnophilia
places.desc: Insomnophilia is erecting the House of Pachi for Axis Mundi. Welcoming back the river otter who walks between worlds — water and land, waking and dream, earthly and celestial. for Axis Mundi. Witness the sacred arc of birth, ministry, daily communion, death, and resurrection across the week. Whether you arrive by chance or by calling, you are expected. Come worship, confess, pray, dance, and drink

places.name: SoundCloud
places.desc:
Welcome to the SoundCloud, your cloud themed portal to high vibe frequencies and dreamy beats. We are a collective of sound lovers sharing music from our cozy cloud lounge. Float with us through ambient sound, deep grooves, and healing vibrations.

Our crew includes sound therapists, healers, ceremonialists, musicians, DJs, and curious explorers united by a love for vibration, frequency, and conne

places.name: Camp Orange Heart
places.desc: Our camp is founded on the principles of unconditional love, mutual respect, honesty, trust, and transparency. Our goal is to provide a deeper intimacy among all human beings with respect to the eight types of intimacy and a mocktail bar for burners. No drama type of camp - only love, respect, and radical acceptance!

places.name: Acorn Oasis
places.desc: Are we human or are we squirrel? Come on down to Acorn Oasis to meet like-minded folks, lose your nuts in carnival games, and feast your eyes on some legendary squirrels. We'll keep our nuts warm for you.

places.name: F.U.Ego Stage Bar & Lounge
places.desc: Egos at the door, snow cones in hand. F.U.Ego is back on the 7:30 B Plaza with our legendary No Mercy Stage. Sing your heart out, get gonged, and get rewarded with access to our A/C VIP Sanctuary. Whether you're here for the fire-breathing art, the 24/7 hydration station, or a top-shelf drink at our newly redesigned lounge, we're your home for high-energy interactivity and low-ego vibes. Come get

places.name: Erotic Inclination Photo Studio
places.desc: Step into the realm of sensual allure: Swing by to EIPS (Erotic Inclination Photo Studio) to create one of a kind photo memory of yourself and your loved one with the help of our resident photo artist. Singles, couples, and groups are welcome to experience unique photoshoots on the outskirts of Black Rock City, where the good old Razorback Mountain sits patiently, providing a stunning natural back

places.name: Astro Cats
places.desc: We invite all burners to chill at the Flying Saucer Lounge with special cocktails during the day, and hot or cold sake or premium Tequila at the Dragon Lounge during the evening. You can enjoy acrobatic, fire dancing performance and workshops at scheduled times, and a place to practice and spin fire with us. If you want to join our kitties for morning yoga or a afternoon tandem running race, bring

places.name: Second Wind Pirate Cafe
places.desc: We're open from 9 PM until we feel like it. It's a pirate-themed coffee bar serving strong black coffee. No milk, no sugar, maybe alcohol. Just bold coffee and a lot of laughs. Our pirate crew runs silly games and keeps the crowd entertained. Outside, two loud pirates with bullhorns heckle and lure people in. It's weird, playful, and a great late-night stop. Come grab a cup and join the chfunaos.

places.name: Black Rock Sauna Society
places.desc: Experience the essence of Finnish sauna culture amidst the Playa's embrace. Our camp offers invigorating sauna sessions, traditional löyly rituals, and the chance to encounter real life sauna elves! Join us for communal relaxation, deep connection, and the transcendent warmth of the Northern spirit.

places.name: Leopard Martini Lounge
places.desc: The LEOPARD MARTINI LOUNGE has been returning since 1998 serving top shelf cocktails in a chill area with wonderful people. The LML BIKE REPAIR SHOP will return this year to support our community. BETTY'S PIE SHOP will continue to serve fresh pie daily in a no rush atmosphere. CLEO the mutant vehicle with continue to roam the playa.

places.name: The Last Starfighters
places.desc: Greetings, Starfighter. You have been recruited by the Star League to defend the playa against commodification & moop. Your participation in supporting artists by building a branch of The Solar Library & giving home to Solarians is to be commended. Your communal effort & civic responsibility will be known across the galaxy. You as a radically self reliant creature have always wanted to fight a des

places.name: FAFA Camp
places.desc: Welcome! We are an international camp and look forward to seeing you at our friendly, cozy camp. Come round mornings and afternoons for our interactivities or to just sit in the shade on our front porch.

places.name: G
places.desc: Welcome to our living room, g. Grab a croissant and dance for an hour or ten. We're grateful you're here.

places.name: Brand-Ur-Ass N More
places.desc:
Brand-Ur-Ass N More will stimulate your entire being -- from your mind to your ass. Bare your butt in the "branding coral" to get one of a number of temporary brands then belly up to our western saloon for some libations. 
Find something/give something at the Giving Tree, hitch a ride on our mutant vehicles or stop by late night to hang around one of our public space fire pits/fire features. Come

places.name: EYERIS
places.desc: Last year we did IRIS photography and had so much fun!! The only change we are making is added a few more members to help us get to more IRIS PHOTOS!!! Come on down and make some crafts while you wait for your turn to get an image of your IRIS! (SOMETIMES we even add something special into the PUPIL!)

places.name: HOT SHOTS
places.desc:
Our camp is a tiny haven for those looking to immerse themselves in the beauty of the desert, fostering moments of connection and self-discovery via our golden hour photo shoots and late night treats. 
Join us at HOT SHOTS, where each sunset marks not just the end of a day, but the beginning of an unforgettable experience.

places.name: Ofosho
places.desc: Good ramen, a great playa moment! Serving the ramen experience on the playa the last 12 years. Doodle or dance to deep house or minimal techno while you wait, noodlessly polaroid yourself or connect with 100s of fellow burners either noodling around or slurping an irresistible bowl of happiness (we have got you covered vegetarians!). Ofosho memorable!

places.name: Soulshakers
places.hometown: Bend Oregon / Queenstown NZ/ Vancouver BC
places.desc: Our camp is a playground for the free-spirited and a home base for nomads with a thirst for connection and adventure. We're a global tribe of dream-chasers and boundary-pushers, supporting each other to live our best lives; from the peaks of New Zealand to the shores of Thailand, and everywhere in between. We are solid as a community and feel that the space we hold between us can inspire other Bur

places.name: The OG Pit
places.desc:
The OG PIT is a little fire, a little fancy, a little filthy—but always family. We build hard, stay late, and never forget why we're here. Whether you're sipping morning mimosa coffee, slapping your way through a late-night meltdown, or screaming karaoke to the stars, you're always welcome in The Pit!
See you in the dust, baby.

places.name: Art Haus
places.desc: A collective of musicians and dancers dedicated to creating classical and contemporary productions on playa and sharing their art with the citizens of Black Rock City. We are a mix of professional and recreational artists and their supporters from all over the world.

places.name: Flat Tire Cafe
places.desc: Welcome to Flat Tire Cafe, your oasis in the dust! Join us every weekday from 10AM to 2PM for iced coffee and expert bicycle repair services. Nestled under a vibrant, colorful shade canopy, our camp offers a haven of relaxation and fun, day or night for all ages! Dive into our interactive game lounge, where laughter and camaraderie flow as freely as our coffee. Whether you're seeking refuge from t

places.name: Frozen Oasis
places.desc: Home of the Dust City Symphony. Shelter from the storm and relax under the misters with a yummy frozen slushy drink and a live classical music performance.

places.name: Impromptu Tomato
places.desc: Your neighborhood coffeeshop serving The Playa's Most Adequate Coffee every morning. Bring your cup. Milks, sugars, light snacks, shade, and good conversation provided. Find us by the giant tomato - our gently cooled and ventilated chill space.

places.name: Yummm
places.desc: Yummm is a camp dedicated to creating Yummmy (non-food) moments for everyone on playa!

places.name: Betty's Bike Shop
places.desc: Bring your broken bike to our camp and With Consent we will help you get to a Happy Ending. We want you Fixed so you can return that familiar and intimate friend back where it belongs. Right Between your legs! A functional Playa Bike; now that's a Happy Ending! Limited Hours of Happiness so Cum Early for Best Results.

places.name: Lovin' Oven
places.desc:
In the middle of the desert: hot, dry and dusty; we bake bread. All week, every morning. Just for you!
Let us feed, host and entertain you. Enjoy freshly baked bread served with tasty toppings, including some vegan loaves everyday; freshly brewed mint tea and unbelievably good vibes! 

Chill out on the suspended cuddle puddle or day beds, have a dance with DJs changing daily, hang out in the shade

places.name: Weird Steel
places.desc: A dynamic Burning Man camp where steel artistry takes center stage. We are a collective of passionate artists and creators dedicated to pushing the boundaries of creativity through the medium of steel and steel-framed art installations. From Rhino Redemption, Medusa, and The Flower Tower, Fire Cathedral, Brass Ring just to name a few. Our camp is a celebration of innovation, imagination, and the t

places.name: Vomiting Sparrows
places.desc: We serve the best Bloody Mary on the playa. We entertain, we make friends, we make fun, we welcome all. Keep an eye and ear open for our special events. Chirp Chirp Blarf!

places.name: The Organization
places.desc: Whether you are tired and in need of energy, or simply heading out on the playa and in need of a drink, stop by our camp for an espresso martini (or simply an iced coffee or non-alcoholic beverage)! Meet and chat with fellow burners while you sit in our shade, lay down in our hammock, rest in our cuddle puddle or jump on our trampoline.

places.name: Oh mi Gato Rat Cafe!
places.desc: Oh Mi Gato Rat Cafe, formerly known as Oh Mi Gato Hat Cafe, formerly known as Oh Mi Gato Cat Cafe, delighting your senses with a combination of Colombian coffee, relaxing yoga movements, really cool hats and Latino party vibes. Drinks, art and music. What else do you need to find your inner beast.

places.name: Camp Piper
places.desc:
A ragtag group of international babes who all appreciate the elegant screeching and sophisticated whine of the bagpipe. Currently seeking a bagpipe player! 
Our camp was founded in 2014 when most of us (being virgin burners) stranded on the playa at the same place, same time. We all woke up to the beautiful sound of the bagpipe. Every since we have been warming wandering souls on the Playa. Stop b

places.name: Après Ski Injury
places.desc:
An interactive camp offering an Après-Ski Bar, a Morning Coffee Bar as well as a thrill ride: A ski ramp in the middle of the desert! Our bar is open every afternoon till late night and offers not only drinks, but entertainment, fun games and fire.
You can also ski!

We will have also events (see WhatWhereWhen) and ski-races.

places.name: Under the Big Top
places.desc: Come visit our camp and enjoy talks and teachings of Qigong energy healing and various other modalities. Relax on the many couches in our chill space with introspective music in the background and fall into some fun and deep conversation about qigong and the meaning of life. Try out some of the dozens of hammocks hanging from an intricate and interesting hammock structure. In the mornings stop by

places.name: Camp Shit Ain't Right
places.desc: Wyoming-based with international flair - campmates from Wyoming, Canada, New Zealand, Russia, Australia, Ukraine, UK Germany, Netherlands... aaaand I'm definitely missing some. Come visit for public lounge, food, movie night, clothing boutique, large-scale, shitty punch and more!

places.name: Tac-O-Cat
places.desc: We are Camp Tac-O-Cat. We cook tacos for the masses and enjoy serving libations and great conversation. We offer shade, a misty breeze and we have a few gear-heads who like to solve problems. Our camp is made up of Burners with deep roots in playa culture and a few we have newly adopted. People will likely be pulled in by heckling when they pass by, and some of the best connections have come from

places.name: Hibernaculum
places.desc: Care to get shot in the box? Get dizzy on the Bat Go Round? Savor Bat Bacon? How about a late night movie or licking your lips with Bat Blueberry Pancakes? At the Hibernaculum, serendipity rules! Know what a Hibernaculum is? Come find out.

places.name: 706 Tribe
places.desc:
Where scattered stories meet - 
a diaspora of makers and dreamers, kindred spirits building home in the nowhere.

Ink in the wind. Roots in the dust. Home in each other.

places.name: Signing Wanderers
places.desc: Silence can be surprisingly loud when hands start talking. Visitors are invited to learn American Sign Language, play visual communication games, and experience Deaf culture in a lively and welcoming space. Try flirting without words, tell stories through signs, and discover how much can be said without speaking. Come join the fun and let your hands do the talking.

places.name: Camp Blowjob
places.desc: Camp Blowjob is where you can let loose and get your leaf blown at Burning Man in a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity! We aim to provide a fun atmosphere where all are welcome!

places.name: Loadie Camp
places.desc: The home of the iconic Shark Car. Loadie Camp is a hive of Mutant Vehicle visionaries and builders, contributing over 10 different Mutant Vehicles of varying sizes. Come meet the builders and learn more about the Mutant Vehicle process.

places.name: Atomic Pussy Photo Lounge
places.desc: Come visit what is easily the 3rd best Bar/Lounge and Photo Booth on the playa. Returning this year is Weir(d) Wednesday, when we'll be serving up a hero dose of the Grateful Dead all afternoon. Also returning this year is our twin-tip, reverse camber Shot-Ski (for those playa face shots), the Elaine Benes Dance Experience (dance classes for dance-introverts) — and of course the photobooth, photo

places.name: HeeBeeGeeBee Healers
places.desc: We are BRC's long-standing oasis for nurturing, grounding and healing. Stop by to hang out and chill, take a class, or to receive a healing session for the mind, body and spirit.

places.name: Wasted Sunshine
places.desc: Frozen Lemonade FOR ALL AGES! Fantastic insults! Booze for consenting adults. AC Lounge chill zone.

places.name: Camp Summer Camp
places.desc: We are a San Francisco-based camp that celebrates the whimsical spirit of Summer Camp. We want to revisit the connection, growth, and playful wonder that comes with those magical childhood weeks. places.name: Black Rock City Welding & Repair
places.desc: Welding, repair, adjustment and general tinkering help. Come on over to use our tools to repair your stuff or get our help repairing what's broken. We repair bikes and all sorts of other things. Enjoy an adult or NA beverage at the Crowbar - our shaded walk up and sit down Bar.

places.name: Ataraxia
places.desc: We're a safe space to: Chill. Laugh. Dance. Meet. Experience. Learn.

places.name: Mo's Mini Martini + Erotica Camp
places.desc: Mohammeds serves the coldest martinis and the hottest erotica on the playa. Come and join us for an ice cold martini in a REAL martini glass and, if the spirit moves you, write down your own true erotic tale in our 400 year old book filled with the daring do's of other Black Rock Citizens. We open after lunch at 1:00pm and close when the camels go to bed, around 1:00am.

places.name: BurningShip
places.desc:
There are Wood Ships, there are Steel ships, but the best ships are "FriendShips."
A bunch of hippie shipmates from all over the world bring their FriendSHIP to the desert for a week of debauchery! Join us at "BurningShip," a cruise ship full of immoral crew that's currently stranded in the desert! We'll be your booze directors, providing you with drinks, smiles, and fun events. Learn how to salsa

places.name: Pink Lightning
places.desc: Pink Lightning is the home of the Burning Man Ultramarathon, and all things running at Burning Man: the 5k, the beer mile, the naked mile, easy mile, and more! Come to run an event or support an event. We also love all things PINK!

places.name: Metal-Morphosis
places.desc:
Camp Metal-Morphosis provides metal workshop M-F 12-2pm.
Make your own pendant and learn metal work skills at our camp.
Some burners come every year !

places.name: Candyland

Come join the fun at CandyLand. Enjoy a sweet treat from one of a dozen retro decorated candy dispensing machines.
After choosing your favorite vodka flavor, get in line at "The Claw" for an opportunity for more treats, and some x-rated sex toys for those over 18.
CandyLand is open every day from 11am - 4 pm for Candy treats, and 1- 4 pm to play "The Claw" to win fun, safe sex toys!

places.name: Camp Shark Cage
places.desc: Welcome to the playa's one and only nautical Nicolas Cage theme camp! Come steal the Declaration of Independence with us.

places.name: Combat Zone
places.desc: We serve the best late night food on the playa. Come see us at 4 am for dan dan noodles and chill beats all week.

places.name: Red Nose District
places.desc: Red Nose District (RND) has been in existence, in one form or another since 1998. In 2013, we resolved to keep our hearts, minds, and noses RED from now until the end of time! RND has roots and participants in LA, SF, Santa Fe, NYC, Las Vegas, Pacific NW, Canada, Israel, France, & various states & countries around the world. Our members are involved in (or are lovers of) the circus arts, & work to

places.name: NO STAIRWAY TO HEAVEN
places.desc:
Musicians and wanderers gather here for open jam sessions where anyone can join the circle with instruments, percussion, or pure curiosity. 

Our signature event, Jam Battle, invites players into a friendly one-on-one improvisational showdown inspired by dance battles and musical conversation.

places.name: Indigo's Speakeasy
places.desc: Serving the finest of fermented bog water since 2010. Come sit and enjoy a dram. Tell us about your latest encounter. We love to listen to a good story.

Who says the most important meal of the day can't also be the sexiest?

places.name: Amateur Hour Playa Pub
places.desc: Welcome, dusty wanderer! Follow the sounds of clanging horseshoes and cheersing beers to cold keg-poured beer/cider and electrolyte salvation. Shaded lounge, backyard games, space for melting, mingling and a swing set for drifting. Bar runs 12—4, Mon—Fri (maybe Sat if the kegs behave). Come thirsty. Stay weird.

places.name: HealAF
places.desc: HealAF is your sanctuary for physical and mental recovery on the playa. We offer air cupping sessions to relieve your exhausted muscles. places.desc: That wonderful feeling that lingers long after the experience has elapsed - a feeling that only occurs when the mind, body, and soul has been ever so stimulated. Our gift to the Playa and to its dear citizens is Afterglow!

places.desc: Horny Camp is an arts & crafts camp with a cheeky, sexy twist. Our crafts can be appropriate for everybody, from children to the childish (but pervy) at heart. places.desc: This is the home of the itinerant Burning Band, here to provide you with an earful of music. Well, two earfuls, really...

places.desc: You know who loves hammocks? Mice love hammocks. If you also love hammocks, you might be a mouse yourself! Come to the Mouse House to get in touch with your inner rodent. Vibes so chill you might find yourself trapped.

places.desc: Mojitos, Music, Shade, Mist & Dancing served up with a warm DeMentha welcome.

places.desc: A welcoming oasis of music, creativity, and connection. Our camp features a large shaded lounge where participants can relax, meet new friends, and enjoy playful daytime gatherings. places.desc: A welcoming neighborhood gathering space rooted in cookout culture and the joyful spirit of the Alphabet Mafia. places.desc: Stumbling around the playa in the dark like a total darkwad? Come get Lit AF! We'll help you add fairy lights to your bike, backpack, or outfit. places.name: BRC3PO (BRC 3:00 Post Office)
places.desc: Set in a giant rural postbox, the Black Rock City 3:00 Post Office (BRC3PO) provides postal services to the citizens of Black Rock City. places.desc: IHOTT (Intergalactic House of Time Travelers) is back with a twist! Grab a cocktail in our glassware from our bartender, or sit down for the best meal you'll have all week!

Welcome to the resurrected Philosophical Center...not a department, not a brand, but a sandbox of inquiry and absurdity. Here, we do what philosophy does best: take your Burning Man-related discomfort, ambiguity, and unresolved contradictions... and roll around in them with delight.

Have a

By night

Welcome to your oasis on the playa! Kick back on our loungers, sip icy-cold refreshments that rotate daily, snack on coconut pancakes, and get ready to make some awesome connections. Whether you're shaking it at our parties, stretching at our yoga class, or enjoying sunset views over BRC from our scaffold, there's no shortage of ways to meet new friends.

places.name: Duckbutt

places.name: Pirate Camp
places.desc: Pirate Camp is a diverse group of experienced burners providing Black Rock City with the finest frozen alcoholic refreshments. Are you too hot and parched to go on? Looking to make new friends? Stop by any afternoon from 1-4pm and hoist a mug with the Pirates. Margarita, Mai Tai, Daiquiri or Pina Colada.

places.name: Sobremesa
places.desc: People arrive for a drink or a taco and somehow stay for hours. Inspired by the Mexican tradition of the sobremesa, this camp recreates that moment after the meal when conversation, music, and laughter keep the table alive. Expect a cozy lounge, tacos from the comal, a communal table that sometimes becomes a dance floor, and plenty of late-night carajillos. Come sit, share stories with strangers,

places.name: Skyhorse Carousel
places.desc: An amusement ride and a piece of art which celebrates human culture and cosmology from ancient to modern times, creating an experience with aspects of both art and play. The horses of the carousel are painted like figures from myth and legend that relate to the sky, bearing, guiding, and embodying the Sun, Moon, and stars for mortal civilization down below. places.name: LOBE
places.desc:
Hypothesis: Scientifically rigorous yet playful participation enhances your burn.

Intro: LOBE invites you to experiment with our placebo bar, sci-art and brain-inspired activities.

Specific Aims:

Aim 1) Are you drunk!? Our speakeasy The Double-Blind Pig serves placebo-controlled refreshments. While you sip, ask the local (inebriated?) scientists all your burning questions (results may vary)

Ai

places.desc: 24-hour Mini-Golf... with a Naughty Twist! Get strokes off your game for committing various 'slutty' acts posted at each our whimsical holes! Swing by the clubhouse for an Arnold Palmer or John Daly during our bar hours, or just relax and enjoy the lounge any time day or night. Innuendo, retina-searing color, and genitalia-themed decor abound. Kindness and consent mandatory-- clothing and class op

places.name: Barbots: Baby Needs A Break
places.desc: Feeling dusty, crooked, or cosmically misaligned? Does Baby Need a Break? The Barbots have you covered. Wander in for pop up bar hours, spa style pampering, karaoke, champagne saber lessons, and our famous Struggle Bus for anyone whose Burn has gone sideways. places.desc:
Our camp is home to our mutant vehicle, Chicken Dragon - Hatchery Gone Wrong. 
Our hatchery has tried to obtain and hatch dragon eggs, but there have been issues, resulting in creatures that look a bit more like chickens. Visitors to our dungeon will see that we are hard at work trying to produce new dragons or chickens, we are not sure what we will get next. Our best hatchling grew large and prot

places.name: Burntown
places.desc: Don't call it a comeback, we been here for years! Burntown is back again ready to ROCK the playa. Come try the Rope Bridge of DEATH. Savor many exotic tobacco and herbal snuff varieties in our SNUFF Emporium. Shop for that special something in our General Store. Relax and enjoy our Art Gallery, which will have all sorts of artwork and guest speakers throughout the week. At Burntown, expect the une

places.name: Honey Puddle
places.desc:
Honey Puddle gives you that warm, sweet, exhilarating feeling of being enveloped by love and friendship. And music and mead and
dancing and light. We're not a quiet camp, we're not a not-quiet camp. We're just right...and we'll be here when you want us. We fit like
warm pajamas.

places.name: Camp Random Pants
places.desc: Need pants? We got you! Take a pair or leave a pair. Relax in our Dome, grab a drink from the bar and enjoy some tunes. Come by for our 10am morning yodel and mimosa social!

places.name: Black Rock Disc Golf Club
places.desc: Black Rock Disc Golf Club has a mushroom-themed disc golf course which embraces fun, games, friendly competition, collaboration, and creativity. We provide a place where folks can join together and throw one of the custom stamped discs loaned out at the camp. You can win one at one of our tournaments or events! The course is accessible 24/7, and discs glow in the dark so don't hesitate to swing by

places.name: BAR MACTROPOLIS
places.desc: We are a full-service Bar. All are welcome. In the morning, we serve coffee, extra libation, and blood Mary's! For the rest of the day come by for a blended drink that you can blend with our custom-made blender or enjoy a cocktail or beer. Our music is chill and our bartenders the best!

places.name: ICU:  Impromptu Crafters Union
places.desc: Suffering from crafter withdrawal? Visit the ICU for a daily dose of creativity in the shade, cuz making Art cures what ails ya! Craft offerings change daily.

places.name: Desert Healers
places.desc:
A welcoming sanctuary will provide a great refuge for those seeking to rest, meditate, decompress or rejuvenate.
Experience Reiki Sessions with Desert Healers

places.name: Amma
places.desc: Meaning: "Mother", we create and hold space for everyone. This is our offering. A communal oasis. A home. A place to be curious and feel nourished. To reset and share our gifts. All are welcome. All are free. All are one.

places.name: Hair of the Dog (HOTD)
places.desc:
HOTD (Hair Of The Dog) is the longest running bar at Burning Man. We hold a piece of the original fire. HOTD gives raw performances and spontaneous acts and entertainment powered by you! HOTD is a donation bar ran on participation and gifts by burners like you! 
If you bring the booze and the music, then we supply the music and the booze!

places.name: Tossed and Sauced
places.desc: Tossed and Sauced -- a few tossers and some fun-loving saucers are making pizza. We will have pizza on three scheduled days and a couple of pop-up parties. Bring good vibes and a napkin.

places.name: Camp Equilibrium
places.desc:
Equilibrium has been established as a destination to represent the pinnacle for the collective first world culture in which we live: vacation. Adhering to a strict belief that our shared time together should be one of joy and relaxation, we seek to strike the all too difficult balance of hard work and play.
It is here that we have constructed a series of spaces and activities to ensure that all wh

places.desc: Lollypopoluis is a theme camp based in Portland Oregon with campers from Portland, Boise, Montreal, CA and Tokyo Japan. We are focused on Self Care and provide the Self Care Pharmacy for those items you may have forgotten or didn't know you'd need. Join us in the Circus tent for music, food, beverages and connection!

places.name: Yes Please
places.desc:
Yes: adv. — Used to express affirmation, agreement, positive affirmation, or consent.
Please: adv. — Give pleasure to or to be pleasing to; give satisfaction.
Yes Please is the answer to every question. Come chill in our calm and revitalizing sanctuary, dance with new friends, and experience our inclusive oasis of sex-positivity, queer empowerment, and love. Be sure to visit our infamous Non-Monog

places.name: Art Car Camp
places.desc:
on Playa since 1994
a Place to gather and get your issues resolved 
To reunite with old friends and make new ones
Gandhi's Garage for mechanical issues
Barter Bob's Lost Camp Supplies for Gear
Lady LaLaLa for seeing your Tomorrow Today through her many skills

places.name: Twilight language
places.desc: A collective of creators on a mission to realize conceptual visual art and cultivate energy around it. Our passion is to create bold, interactive, innovative, and novel experiences. Or maybe it's just the world's best pizza party...

places.name: Whynauts
places.desc:
Come enjoy our Cosmic Cabana Series (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday Afternoons): Whynauts' signature afternoon oasis sanctuary from the playa's heat. 

Each day features a unique theme aligned with the Axis Mundi concept - from grounded human connection to celestial artistic offerings. 

Step into a sanctuary designed to restore and soothe: by being nourished with hand-fed frozen grapes, delicious q

places.name: Astral Outpost
places.desc: Astral Outpost is a place where the ethereal meets the earthly.

places.name: Camp Bare Tentacles
places.desc: We offer a simple mix of bodywork, basic hospitality, and low key communal space. On Monday and Thursday afternoons we serve hot dogs/vegan dogs and easy tropical cocktails, giving neighbors a chill place to pause and refuel. places.name: Abstininthe
places.desc: The friendly bar on the playa, providing our special drink to the thirsty of BRC since the last millennium. Come try our many flavors and enjoy the music, ambiance and conversation of our neighborhood bar. Now serving non-alcoholic shrubs.

places.name: Amulet
places.desc: Whether you seek magic or inspiration, join us at Camp Amulet for a morning pineapple pancake, and find out where and when our next Amulet pop-up will be. At our Amulet table, you'll be gifted a brass dog tag; pre-stamped with the Burning Man symbol. Our highly skilled Amulet Counselors will guide and inspire you to make your mark, and answer the great pressing questions of your life as you custom

places.name: Dome on the Range
places.desc: Yeehaw! We're your Dome away from Home! Slingin' mystery drinks and curious cures for all that ails ya. We're the weird neighborhood waterin' hole you keep comin' back to. Whether just starting your night or wandering your weary way home, come saddle up to the bar; we've got a cure for all that ails ya.

places.name: Camp Castaway
places.desc: A welcoming, shaded, interactive neighborhood lounge where participants of all ages can stop in, engage, and connect. Our primary gift to Black Rock City will be freshly prepared micheladas, a traditional Mexican beer cocktail made with beer, savory Bloody-Mary-style mix, and chili-lime salt on the rim. We offer life size games, lively conversation, and will gift Nevada pendants one day during the

places.name: Camp Butter
places.desc:
Not only a camp of deliquescent souls. It is a movement... a way of sliding through life with a groove at your sails.
Equipped with DJ's, Butter-Inspired drinks, and a universal deep desire to churn ~ We're here to spread a simple message...
"Talk less, slide more" ~
Come see the WORLD'S BIGGEST BUTTER STICK !!

places.name: Giraffè Caffè
places.desc: We blend the invigorating spirit of Burning Man with the universal love for coffee. Each day, we serve up an eclectic mix of fun, innovative coffee creations that awaken the senses and fuel the soul. From espresso-infused adventures to creamy concoctions that defy the ordinary, our camp is a haven for coffee enthusiasts and curious souls alike. Join us for a cup of joy, connection, and creativity

places.name: NetsaH
places.desc: Explorers and curious souls, every shared energy is etched into eternity.

places.name: Dust Circus

places.name: A-PLAYA-MASK

places.name: Sparkle Love
places.desc: Come experience a little Sparkle Love in our beautiful oasis Tiki lounge, enjoy a cold drink and make new friends. We are a colorful and eclectic crew of sex positive, queer friendly, Sparkle Lovers and Burning Man family with an international flair. Cold drinks, hot friends, sexy games, groovy beats, rainbow colors all around.

places.name: Celestial Bodies
places.desc: For 22 years, Celestial Bodies has been your friendly, all inclusive, gay bar on the playa. Brining you fun, daily events in a welcoming environment.

a safe and cozy place to party, relax and meet new friends!

places.desc: Step into SoulSound, where rhythm meets ritual and every soul becomes part of the tribe. Guided by sound and spirit, we gather like modern day Vikings around the pulse of music. places.desc: Kurenivka is a Ukrainian camp built around art, hospitality, and a touch of beautiful absurdity. Check the schedule for having your reading done.
or just come cool off in the shade and watch the world go by.

places.name: Penny Smashing Point
places.desc:
Bring your dusty body to our camp,
Smash a penny like a champ.
Add a chain, a clip, a hook,
Wear your keepsake on the playa—take a look.
Paint your body, be the art,
Leave with magic you helped start..

places.name: Bao Chicka Wow Wow
places.desc:
Come hungry, not hangry.

Fill your belly with our fresh and delicious steamed-to-order pork, red-bean, and custard bao.

Sunday Sunset: 5pm - 8pm (SUN)
Brunch: 11am - 2pm (MON, TUES, WED)

places.name: RhythmWave

places.name: Black Rock Yearbook

places.name: The Astral Social Club
places.desc: A home on the playa for experimental, ambient, acoustic, classical and celestial music. Indulge in our house made elixirs and tinctures at our non-alcoholic bar; let your consciousness slip through our transdimensional portal. Elevate and expand.

places.name: Soon to be Infamous
places.desc: Your burn is Soon to Be Infamous! Stop by and decorate a flag with your playa name and address during our Don't Fucking Leave Your Fucking Bike on the Fucking Playa! Bicycle Flag Creation Station Events and help us end bikicide, the careless abandonment of an innocent bike to wither and die on the playa.

places.name: Discosmos

tired of having fun in the sun? take a momento for downtempo.
come chill with us at Malio's, the bar with the best view on the playa

Come be a character in our quirky little variety show.

places.name: Best Butt

Draw a Blessing Card, leave a Love Note, and stay a little longer than you planned. Come for the aroma and curiosity, stay for the conversation and human connection.

places.desc: Welcome to Camp Morning Wood! Which is, quite simply, your friendly, neighborhood, summer camp-themed, saloon. Starting fresh each morning at 10:00 a.m. to "Eye of the Tiger" we're there to motivate the neighborhood, to attack a new day (after licking our wounds from the night before). CMW is ready to greet you with a smile, music, dancing, or maybe just a view of the city from our raised platform

places.name: Just Dandy
places.desc: Support camp for Dandy mutant vehicle.

places.name: Edna's Oasis

Home of the world famous Orgy Dome — where couples & moresomes of all orientations are invited to come and play. We welcome the combination of love in all forms.

Everyone wishing to enter the Orgy Dome receives a detailed orientation covering Informed Enthusiastic Consent. Remember

Committed to spreading love and healing to the citizens of Black Rock City through guided meditation, genuine connection, emotional support and real

places.name: Nocino's

We have daily events such as panel discussions featuring game devel

places.desc: A lovely camp, which has been giving away lingerie and pasties in exchange for a good life story for over 10 years now, serving snow cones in the afternoon sun and filled with people from all over the world, whose paths to our camp are always somehow unique and worth a story.

Located at the heart of Burning Man, our camp offers a unique and immersive experience inspired by the soothing power of steam. Enter our tranquil oasis and indulge in the therapeutic benefits of steam bathing, surrounded by the sights, sounds, and scents of the desert
