places.desc: A Mighty Misfit is a person whose behavior or attitude sets them apart from others in a conspicuous way, yet somehow makes it okay. A fish out of water, square peg in a round hole, round peg in a square hole. If you've ever felt you don't fit in in the default world, come and play with the Mighty Misfits. We are a welcoming, dusty respite with a misfit list of activities. Feed your body and soul w

places.name: Hang-Out, the
places.desc: Nestled in the heart of the desert, between Home Brew and the lovely sounds of the Playa Jazz Cafe, you will find the Hangout. This will be your ultimate sanctuary for connection, creativity, and good vibes. We're a vibrant community where artists, explorers, and free spirits come together to relax, share, ignite their inner fire and recharge their depleted bodies in our two dozen shaded hammocks.

places.name: The Society of Supreme Excellence
places.desc: The Society (for the Pursuit) of Supreme Excellence cordially invites you to pursue excellence in all facets of existence. We're here to support your journey towards pursuing excellence through a variety of excellent activities, including revitalising elixirs, nourishing pizza & supremely soul soothing bass.

places.name: Salty Jacks
places.desc: Your local deep dive bar and your safe-port in the storm, open daily. A nautical disco grotto with salty libations and an eclectic fleet of DJs.

places.name: Burning Sky
places.desc: Skydivers over Burning Man. Come see Black Rock City from 9,000 feet in the air. Watch the skydivers exit the plane while you stay safely inside and get an exciting ride back to the earth. Gifting rides Wednesday & Thursday & Friday 11a-5p.

places.name: Burning My Crêpe
places.desc: Lighting up the Playa since 2018 with the best flamed crêpes you'll ever eat. Made from scratch by people from Brittany (crêpe's original birthplace), you'll be mesmerized by our pole dancers while enjoying our crêpes in our cozy living room!

places.name: Hot Stuff
places.desc: Drinks served from dawn onward for the thirsty traveler crossing the desert sands. All manner of chilli hot and ice cool refreshments will be on offer accompanied by music from storied DJs from across the savage sands.

places.name: TOT
places.desc: Where people are nice, the swing set is big and where you are welcome.

places.name: PlayAground
places.desc: We are playground with radical swings, shade, lounge, bar, games, music & art.

places.name: Gnometopia
places.desc:
Stop by any afternoon to partake in some Gnometivities:
Sing some Gnome songs
Hear a Gnome talk
Become a Gnome!
Get a Gnome massage while listening to Gnome harp
Trade Gnome outfits
Complete a Gnome Quest

Join us for Gnome Night on Thursday night as we explore the playa together as a flock of Gnomes.

There's Gnome telling what will happen at Gnometopia!

places.name: Shitty Glitter
places.desc: A boutique Bed and Breakfast providing the most luxurious hospitality experience in Black Rock City. Stop by for a rest in the clean white linens of a freshly made canopy bed (changed daily) and be sure to chat with a camp concierge to get the most of your stay. Swing by The Parlor on Wednesday evening for our "Breakfast Taco Tuesday (For Dinner On Wednesday)" where we'll be serving breakfast taco

places.name: Chico Urban Area
places.desc: Climb aboard the Intergalactic Transporter for a trip across the Playa you will never forget! We are happy to give you a cold beverage, space to dance, chill or just meet new people.

places.name: Now and Then Artist Collective
places.desc: We are a group of artists who have worked together on many projects over the years. Our goal is to support each other so we can get our art to playa and camp together. New artists are welcome.

places.name: Space Bar
places.desc: A group of humans committed to supporting art at Black Rock City. Come meet us at our art sculpture or in our open-to-all shade structure at camp.

places.name: Potty Project
places.desc: Home of the Potty Project a group of volunteers helping teach LNT at the potties and make the potties fun! We offer volunteer shifts M-F of the event so stop in to sign-up!

places.name: Snark Bar
places.desc: A Snarky experience awaits day or night, take a spin on the prize wheel if you dare! Our Dick n Ball pit awaits those that would prefer a cozy lightshow with a touch of nostalgia. Snark, shade, couches, a dome with hammocks and excellent drinks await dusty hot travelers of the day. WIFI Available - intermittently!

places.name: Mostly in Tune
places.desc:
Leave with dusty shoes and a song stuck in your head.

Mostly in Tune is a participatory jam camp. Join the band, borrow an instrument, sing along, enjoy live band karaoke, perform spoken word over live backing tracks, or simply enjoy the music. No experience required.

Want to join a camp and actually make music? We’re looking for a drummer and keyboard player to complete our house band. (Unt

places.name: Campoline
places.desc: We are an artsy international dive bar of friendly folks and stiff drinks under the circus bigtop of cascading parachutes. You can jump on trampolines under the stars or sun, paint, stroll through art work, belly up to the bar, listen to canned music from show tunes to punk, watch live original music and varied performances, or climb the intellectual ladder of conversation. Just depends on the nig

places.name: Camp BUI
places.desc: The friendliest camp on the playa famous for our front porch. Drop by for a visit and a cold drink. Join us at sundown for a Shot of the Day or Thursday from 2:00 to 4:00pm for our Pineapple Upside Down Cake Thursday event. We are well known for our fine cuisine and repartee.

places.name: Moon Cheese
places.desc: We still believe the moon is made out of cheese. That's why we serve grilled cheese sandwiches throughout the week to the hungry citizens of Black Rock City. Stocked with all different types of bread & cheese and a range of sweet, spicy, tangy & juicy dipping sauces, we're grilling under the stars to satisfy the cravings of all those dancing & adventuring at night.

places.name: Above & Below
places.desc: Art Support Camp for Above and Below Honorarium Art Installation.

places.name: Dr. Playa's ENT Clinic
places.desc: Dr Playa's ENT Clinic helps Black Rock Citizens clean out their head holes daily. Open 12PM-3PM. Since 1792

places.name: Great Vibrations
places.desc: Welcome to Great Vibrations. Our camp is a sanctuary of movement, relaxation, and high-frequency energy, dedicated to restoring and elevating Burners through the power of vibration. We offer 24/7 zero gravity massage chairs, daytime spa services (12pm-5pm), and a Tuesday morning sunrise dance party you will not want to miss!

places.name: Glowskull Asylum Int'l
places.desc: Glowskull Asylum Int'l brings extreme metal radical inclusion to the playa. Are you craving some good headbanging and want to meet exotic misfits from random places all over the world? Our bar, Skøllushery, and art car "Castle Glowskull" will be hosting mischief, ultra-violence, and twisted METAL (and other deranged forms of terrible music) daily. All varieties of humans welcome!

places.name: Base Camp
places.desc: Home and landing pad for the Metro Chop mutant vehicle. A working camp where stuff gets done so the Black Rock City can have some fun.

places.name: PO9
places.desc: We connect you with the world, we are the original way to get USPS mail to the playa, as we have been for decades. We do: USPS to the Playa, Playa to any (international) address with a unique artistic postmark! (US postage encouraged/required), and friendly (and not-so-friendly) posties: stand in line, and fill out your form... in triplicate... with crayon.

places.name: MacGyvers' Union
places.desc: Every camp has a MacGyver -- now the MacGyvers have a union. We provide all MacGyvers with recognition, thanks, tools, training, entertainment, emotional and moral support, chill space away from their home camp, and an official ID card.

places.name: Half Baked
places.desc:
Make your Official 2026 Solar Shrink-Art necklaces, earrings, keychains, bike tags & hat swag using our solar ovens. All art supplies and ovens will be provided. You COLOR it. You watch it SHRINK. You WEAR it! Walk away with some cool, commemorative, self-made swag, along with a greater understanding of the wonderful world of solar baking. 

Also, try our Tabletop Tug Challenge. You've always want

places.name: Soul Forge
places.desc: Take a deep dive into personal growth and learning - Hammer out your spirit at Soul Forge!

places.name: Critical Connections
places.desc: Connections make us a collective being. They are all critical to us. And Puppets.

places.name: Planned Playahood
places.desc: We offer "second aid" services including contraceptives, pregnancy tests, and hygiene products and a Menstruation Station to help you stock up on your needs. Pay homage to Our Lady of the Shaven Beaver, where you can experience your playa rebirth. climb our tower or use the couch swing, get a faux-scription from our camp 'doctors' for whatever ails you, and visit The Museum of Dildonts (items you

places.name: Hippocampus
places.desc: Dust off your goggles and follow the scent of sizzle to Hippocampus, where the griddle is hot and the coffee is bottomless! We're serving up fluffy flapjacks and radical connections to fuel your morning art adventures, so bring a plate and leave with a new playa family. Once the sun climbs high, return for Liquid Courage Karaoke to gift your wildest, dust-filtered vocals to the desert sky. Whether

places.name: Redhanded
places.desc: Has your period caught you red-handed? We've got your back! Stop by our elegant Victorian period lounge for refreshing drinks (N/A options available), and precious period supplies while enjoying fun live events. Got dust in curious places? We'll help you freshen up sustainably. Need extra care? We offer support when you're bleeding or just having a tough day. Oh, and we've got pee funnels, because

places.name: We < 3 CamPINK!
places.desc: Join in our Family Reunion! We have large yard games for day and night play, Dj sets and our signature CamPINK! Karaoke after dark. Drop by our fabulously monochrome camp and tell us how PINK it is while you play tic-tac-toe, connect4, LED bocce, cornhole or glow Jenga. Or have a fancy cocktail while lounging in a shaded hammock enjoying our hospitality and PINKness. Everyone's a WINNER at CamPINK

places.name: Giraffelot
places.desc: Like Lancealot, Camelot, you know?imagine walking through the dusty roads of Black Rock City and coming across a Renaissance Faire? but giraffes.

places.name: Playa Pinups and Fine Art Fatales
places.desc: We are a camp consisting of Photographers, Models, Muscians and Artists dedicated to capturing the beauty and diversity of the citizens of Black Rock City, while offering an opportunity to enhance personal expression through the creation of several types of art.

places.name: Discrace
places.desc:
Do you know how much beer can fit inside a frisbee? Join us to find out, play ultimate frisbee, and other fun competitions with fellow burners!

Ultimate Frisbee is an inclusive, spirited community based around a self-officiated "sport", with events primarily organized by players themselves and gifting each other silly things. Sure feels a lot like Burning Man to us.

We're here to share ultimate

places.name: Armageddon Bike Camp
places.desc: It's not the end of the world, it's the safe word! Think Armageddon for all your bike needs. We've been providing Bike Love Bike Repair on-playa for almost 20 years, and we offer professional bike repair daily. Or fix your own bike at our Public Bike Repair station, 24x7! We also host great parties, don't miss our Wednesday afternoon Alley Cat Race and After Party with Funny Bike Demo! Our well-st

places.name: Champagne Lounge
places.desc: Welcome to the Champagne Lounge! Amidst Black Rock City's hustle, our oasis offers luxurious relaxation. Step into our elegantly adorned shade, sip champagne poured by less than knowledgeable bartenders, and recline on plush playa-tech or mingle with fellow Burners. As the sun sets, enjoy twinkling lights and ambient music for a magical atmosphere. Cheers to the extraordinary!

places.name: Battle Born Burners
places.desc: Come play, drink and lounge with us. The only bar on the playa with Nevada-tude!

places.name: Tour de Chance
places.desc: Êtes-vous chanceux? Ride the the Playa's largest French-themed bicycle-powered carnival game for marvelous prizes! But vélo beware, some are risqué.

places.name: Deep Eat
places.desc: Get ready to Deep Eat with delicious food and feast your eyes on Lucifera, while enjoying respite from the playa.

places.name: Cloudy AF
places.desc:
Feel the thunder as we BUFF and FLOG your muscles at Body Werkz, get foggy in the Steamy AF sauna, get wisped away in our evolving sprinkles of frosty bevies, drift away in a dream in our cloud pit!
We are dedicated to raising the hearts, body and souls of the broader Burning Man community through our art, events, and welcoming space. We dew take our fun quite cirrus-ly.
It's never been this cool

places.name: Paper Cranes
places.desc: At our camp, we strive to create a home on the playa - a place where our campers feel just as excited to return after a long day as they are to dive into our interactive events. We keep it simple but meaningful: serving up PB&Js, letting our DJs set the vibe, and coming together each night for a family meal you won't want to miss. At the heart of our tradition, we invite visiting burners to write

places.name: Abominable Base Camp
places.desc: Home of the Yeti Mob. We host a welcoming base camp for BRC citizens--providing cool daytime vibes and an immersive lit nighttime environment. ABC will have live DJs, parties, workshops, a book nook, and a bar for custom infused vodka tasting. Come get abominable with us.

places.name: Shangri-Lounge
places.desc: Camp of amazing humans who support the Shangri-Lounge bicycle-drawn mobile martini bar. If you can find us in Deep Playa late at night, we'll serve you the finest cocktail you've ever had while you relax in intimate conversation with new friends under the stars.

places.name: A Touchy Subject
places.desc: A shady spot to relax, confess, break the ice, forget about a postcard, meet a friend, or get away. Brought to you by those shady folks who didn't serve waffles.

places.name: Molotov Cocktail
places.desc:
Our shaded bar/chill space offers welcome respite and comfort for the dusty and thirsty.
We will be bringing a variety of home brewed and concocted alcoholic beverages for the citizens of Black Rock City.
We offer a variety of games including cribbage and ten thousand/farkle.

places.name: Happy Hour
places.desc: Hard day on the playa? Unwind at Happy Hour, where you'll be greeted by one of a kind refreshing spirits served with smiles! Enjoy our lounge, bar, and dance floor! Start your day with Happy Hour!

places.name: Chatterbox Camp
places.desc: Immerse yourself in the vibrant cacophony of creativity with the Chatterbox Art Car. This rolling masterpiece serves as a mobile platform for spontaneous conversations, fueled by the energy of the playa. Adorned with mesmerizing humans and pulsating with music, the Chatterbox invites participants to engage in dynamic dialogues, forging connections that transcend boundaries. Join the journey aboard

places.name: Burnstream Court
places.desc: Burnstream Court is a group of Airstream owners who recreate a 1960s trailer park, Black Rock City style. We almost always have fun daytime events happening that you can join in with. And we give away grilled cheese sandwiches midday M-F.

places.name: Emergence with  Buddha Lounge
places.desc: Facebook Emergenceartcar

places.name: 2 girls 1 camp
places.desc:
We're slinging slushies—The No.1 (Yellow) and The No.2 (Brown).
Fiber-spiked for flow, booze-spiked for fun.

Join us in the Center Camp Oculus for traditional coconut oil wrestling—thumbs welcome, dignity optional, hilarity guaranteed.

places.name: IGNITED STATES
places.desc:
Ignited States is all about our states of mind, our states of being, our states of consciousness. It's about lighting up our worlds. It's about igniting and fanning the flames of our creativity. And sometimes, it's about igniting the fire in our bellies with a shot of fireball.

- Ignite your artful state by making a flag to illustrate the state you're in 
- Ignite your wakeful state with beverage

places.name: Deep C
places.desc: Deep C presents: HypnoDrome — a dazzling 26-foot dome lit by over 25,000 LEDs! Step into the light and get lost in an immersive sea of color, rhythm, and movement. By day, it's a shaded oasis to relax, chill, and connect. By night, it transforms into a vibrant beacon of sound and light—perfect for dancing, lounging, or just being hypnotized by the show. Come drift in the Deep.

places.name: Orgy Bus Camp
places.desc: Orgy Bus Camp provides a safe and clean space for play parties on the playa. All of our parties have an opening ceremony where we practice consent and boundaries, as well as a fun and interactive opportunity to meet other guests. Our parties are at 3 PM and 11 PM daily.

places.name: Black Rock City Municipal Pool
places.desc: Looking for a place to cool down and relax? The Black Rock City Municipal Pool might be the place for you! There's something for everyone: come by for a refreshment and shady misting during one of our Open Swim sessions, swing through at night for a bit of poolside lounging in peace, or put your dancing boots to good use at our Spring Break party! Access to our Spa is supposed to only be available

places.name: PALINKA LOUNGE
places.desc: Palinka Lounge offers a welcoming respite for Burners new and old around the globe, we offer a comfortable environment for Burners to take a moment to relax, have a drink, introduce themselves, and learn about what it means to be a burner (or learn about Hungarian burners) gaining from our camp-members Burning Man knowledge. We do this not only through sharing a drink, but also by engaging in acti

places.name: Never Sleep Again
places.desc: Inspired by the vibes of Berlin nightclubs and the global underground party scene, we bring deep, groovy beats to an intimate dance floor enclosed by lush chill spaces with beds, couches, cushions, and pillows for when you need to reset. Drift between dancing, lounging, sharing a drink, playing games, and getting lost in moments with other burners. Our space pulses with sound, curiosity, mischief,

places.name: SophistaPirate Cove
places.desc:
Word travels about a Pirate port on Esplanade, a place the SophistaPirates built when they decided to make something worth staying for.
During the day, it's a place to settle in: shaded lounges, games at Kracken's Trap, a stop at Captain Cooks, and stories shared at the Thirsty Pearl.
But it doesn't stay quiet for long.
By night, the ship wakes up. Music, fire sails, and projection art take over,

places.name: Stardust Lounge
places.desc: Enter an interdimensional portal that leads to a magical experience comprised of love, silliness, and sparkly things! Stardust Lounge is an eclectic pit stop for dusty travelers on their inter-playatary journeys. The three sections of the camp--the Lounge, Spa, and Wedding Chapel--offer visitors a fun blend of rituals, games, and opportunities for self-care.

places.name: Halloween Camp
places.desc: Halloween Camp presents brings out the inner child in all of us BOO-urners, taking us back to the delights of that special day, where anybody can be anyone. Stop by our Diskull Lounge for a moment of respite, dance, and connection!

places.name: Cinderbox
places.desc:
An art support camp for the Resilience Art Collective. We are part of a HUB with our two dear sister camps, Fingerbang! and Chico Urban Area - come find us for a visit! 
We are proud recipients of a 2026 BRC Honoraria Grant for our placed art project, Resilience, a larger-than-life flaming tardigrade which will be waiting somewhere on the playa to welcome you!

places.name: Society for Temporal Preservation
places.desc:
The Society for Temporal Preservation consists of time travelers tasked with preserving the fabric of spacetime. Space time is like a cat though, it takes care of itself. This is good, because now we can leave a bowl of food out and ignore it while we visit Black Rock City. We serve as ambassadors of the temporally free, working to introduce Black Rock City to the magic (science) of time travel.
O

places.name: Camp SnuggleFunk
places.desc: Step into a world of pure playa funk, where every moment is infused with vibrant energy and creative flair. This camp offers inviting relaxation zones to unwind and recharge, alongside dynamic dance spaces where funky beats keep spirits soaring. Engage in playful activities ranging from spontaneous art jams to quirky games, all designed to spark imagination and joyful connections. Here, originalit

places.name: French Manila
places.desc: Our camp is inspired by the melting pot of different cultures and backgrounds of our camp members who are from America, Canada, France, and the Philippines. Our founding crew met in Manila and San Francisco many years ago and we bonded over art, good food, and exploring these cities together. As our family grows over the years, one thing stays true, on playa we love hosting late afternoon themed h

places.name: Good Question
places.desc:
What can you expect from our camp? Good Question!

Stop by our shady oasis to deepen your connection with your friends and loved ones, or meet a new friend entirely in a cozy, intimate atmosphere. You'll leave feeling more connected to others, and having formed a deeper connection with yourself.

Come by in the afternoon when we will be serving tea, Dosas (Indian breakfast like a crepe) and batch

places.name: Coffee and Pasties
places.desc: Bringing organic peculator coffee / nitro cold brew back the Playa with great things to add like Whiskey or Irish cream and of course all the colorful pasties! And please come sit by our fire!

places.name: SnowKoanSolar
places.desc: Snow Koan Solar serves snow cones daily, hot dogs very late at night now and then, and provides solar-based power for a number of camps in our HUB. We also have a public charging station where smaller items can be charged.

places.name: Second Rodeo
places.desc:
Howdy, y'all!

Second Rodeo welcomes any and all participants to enjoy cheeky and fun rodeo-themed activities, offerings, and wild hoedowns! If it ain't a party you seek, we also specialize in providing self care amenities to those seeking respite.

Let us prove to you that this isn't our first rodeo! Come as you are, every one of y'all!

Yeeeeehaw!

places.name: Camp Tidy
places.desc: Enjoy a proper cuppa at tea time and peruse our extensive collection of literature in the Tea and Porn lounge. Recharge yourself and your devices with our solar powered charging station.

places.name: Alma Borekas
places.desc:
Moroccan atmosphere with Middle Eastern influence. Traditional chilling area and an open bar serving signature cocktails from 12 PM to 2 PM. 

Our legendary Borekas will be served on Tuesday, and mint tea will warm you up at night.
Our welcoming seating area is for YOU to relax or go partying, depending on the hour.

places.name: Flying Pegasus
places.desc:
Fulfilling Fanciful Flying Ferry Function (for a Fucked-up Flat-Foot)

Wire-art Pegasus 'flying' mutant vehicle presenting in MOBL form providing fanciful transportation and refreshments

places.name: Chain Reaction
places.desc:
Bike acting up out on playa? Pull up.

We're a laid back bike repair camp helping people get rolling again from 11am to 6pm every day. Flats, loose chains, brakes acting weird, or just need air, we've got you. No appointments, no stress, just swing by.

Need a break from the sun? Hang out for a bit, cool down, and kick it with us while we work. Good people, good energy, and a spot to reset before

places.name: The Island
places.desc: A French-speaking camp sharing the spirit of Polynesia at Burning Man. Come discover a warm and relaxing space inspired by Tahiti, with traditional monoï oil massages, cultural touches, and an inviting island atmosphere

places.name: Hot Noodz
places.desc: Stop by for diy noodles, possibly leather branding and ink stamping.

places.name: SolarPlus
places.desc: A free solar-powered community charging lounge offering e-bike, scooter, and device charging to all citizens of Black Rock City. Powered entirely by renewable energy, our shaded lounge is open daily with hosted shifts, welcoming anyone who rolls up with a dead battery. No fees, no VIP access just a genuine gift to keep Black Rock City moving.

places.name: Healing Foot Wash Life Truth Love
places.desc: Life, Truth, Love: Come sit under our cooling shade canopy and get your feet washed, dried and moisturized in a tranquil and calming environment. After you have received this gift, you are invited to participate as well. We are actively building world peace and community.

places.name: Lusty Chanterelle Kombucha Bar
places.desc: Whisky is out- Kombucha is in. The Lusty Chanterelle Kombucha bar is a place to cool down, relax, unwind, and drop in with good conversation and a cold non-alcoholic beverage with your fellow burners. Come with an empty cup and we will fill you up and help you feel at home with the most quaffable drink on playa.

places.name: Illumination Village
places.desc:
Illumination Village is an eclectic gathering of camps, held together by history and shared resources. You will find within the village, much like the microcosm of Burning Man, art and interactivity everywhere. 
Step into a glowing neighborhood where fire, light, music, and human connection collide. By day, find coffee, tea, a public steam bath, workshops, and welcoming spaces to rest, learn, and

places.name: Phonic Bloom
places.desc: Join us to experience a sound-reactive light show. Sing, play instruments, or just relax and enjoy a synesthesia-inspired experience in a relaxing and intimate environment.

places.name: Burner Buddies
places.desc: We are a relaxed LGBTQI+ camp known for Genital Printmaking based on a traditional Japanese technique, plus throwing some fabulous cocktail parties.

places.name: Monkey King Camp
places.desc:
A playful cultural playground on the Playa filled with DJ sets, music, interactive art, games, drinks, Asian inspired food gifting, and Monkey King energy. 
Come explore our Dragon Pillars, catch live sets from DJs and artists on our stage, hang out in our lounge spaces, share tea, snacks, and good vibes, and jump into spontaneous moments of fun with fellow Burners. 
By day and night, our camp i

places.name: Camp Synthesis
places.desc: Embodies the melding of three things: Synthesizers, Sake, and Sushi. Here's the concept: People who like producing music with synths, midi instruments, drum machines, etc., hanging out, jamming, teaching others to make music, performing live sets, share Japanese food, and sharing a drink. Daytime events: come jam on synths. Bring a synth or come play around with ours. Following the Food/Bar (takoy

places.name: Black Rock City Shipyard
places.desc:
Where good vibes meet great times!
Sip cocktails, savor glitzy hot dogs, and sway to groovy beats in a chilled lounge atmosphere. 

Cruise in, kick back, and let the party float you away

places.name: The Club
places.desc: A Joker-run casino parody where nobody wins money but everyone risks becoming part of the show. Play two games - Twenty One My Ass and Deez Roulette. Bring a joke, a story, or something strange with you. Welcome to a casino run by people who should not run casinos.

places.name: Uncle Larry's Misguided Burners
places.desc: Home of KART Radio on 88.3FM! Listen to live music while getting weird on the streets of BRC!

places.name: Camp Scone Fucker
places.desc: Come get Sconed with us. 9 unique flavors to try throughout the week and ice cold tea to wash it down. All while grooving to our camp DJs R & B, House, Rock, and Lo-Fi beats. Come chill out in the shade with a glass of ice tea or partake in our playground. Maybe we will have a fun surprise or two.. or three?

places.name: Camp TeaPunk
places.desc: Stop by our Steampunk inspired tea/coffee/cocktail tent and chill for a bit. With victorian furniture, plush rugs, a cuddle puddle, small library and games you're sure to feel welcome as you prop your feet up and relax. Looking for something more upbeat? Our "Teabag Olympics" might be for you. With relay races in high heals, granny panty competitions and other hilarious happenings, you're sure to

places.name: Vivarium
places.desc: Step into a playful, welcoming front porch living room where conversation, comfort, and curiosity come first. Expect a mix of sensory delights, language lessons, music jams, whiskey and bad advice, and late-night grilled cheese hospitality. This is a camp for lingering, laughing, learning something unexpected, and connecting with strangers who may not stay strangers for long. Whether you stop in f

places.name: Camp Sweaty Betty
places.desc:
Can't tell which is dustier - body, mind, or soul? It's probably your hair. Friendly neighborhood hair washing salon - stop in and get yo'self correct head to foot - hell, bring a partner and we can teach them how, too. Plenty of gossip, probably a little therapy.

Open Monday - Friday 11:00 am - 3:00 pm

places.name: Nom De Plume
places.desc: We are a tea lounge that has yerba mate brewing the entire event in our circus tent. Come by to kick it, chill, and lounge. Relax while thriving, and drinking tea. Yerba Mate Dub starts every day at 10:30am. Classic dub s

places.name: Black Rock Yacht Club
places.desc: We share our love of sailing by offering instruction, and use of our fleet of wind-powered rigs

places.name: StarFist
places.desc:
Infamous international tea service Mon-Sat 2-5pm serving a delightful selection of hot and cold infusions from around the world as we pamper and delight our guests. Offering a refuge from heat and dust, unparalleled hospitality and secret surprises for the lucky few. 

Morning meditation/yoga sessions most days at 11:11am and our fascinating evening StarFist Lecture Series, exploring a range of th

places.name: Honkers Harbor
places.desc:
Calling all curious birds, early risers, and soulful squawkers.
If you've been flying solo or searching for your flock, Honkers Harbor might be your next cozy nest.

We're a neighborhood sanctuary for honkers, wanderers, and high-flyers - rooted in connection, ease, and a little morning magic.

Perch beneath fluttering fabrics. Start your day with a warm breakfast or a hydrating refreshment. Settl

places.name: Camp Delicioso & Creperie
places.desc: Hungry! Hung over? You've been hankerin' for something warm in your belly? Swing on by Camp Delicioso and Crêperie, where you'll find an International collective of foodies who'll entertain and serve you the best damn OG French crêpe in Black Rock City. places.name: Vault 21+
places.desc:
Vault 21+ invites you to step into our 23-hour-a-day dive bar?that's right, 23 hours. If you're roaming the wasteland and thirsting for a drink, there's a good chance we're open? unless it's sunrise. In that case, take a moment to soak in the irradiated sunrise, then return when the time is right. We'll still be here, with a cold drink waiting for you.

places.name: So Far So Good
places.desc: Step up to a familiar machine that offers something extraordinary. This ATM does not dispense money, but stories. Speak a memory, a longing, or a truth, and receive a small printed story shaped from your words. Come withdraw something you cannot buy.

places.name: OLYMPVS
places.desc: Olympvs is a theatrical courtyard where curiosity, connection, and sensual exploration come to life. places.name: Barbie Day Spa
places.desc: Get pampered at Barbie Day Spa: Fingernail painting, foot soaks, foot massage, body wash, erotic massage, cold drinks.

places.name: Playa Alterations
places.desc: Playa Alterations is your one-stop shop for chopping, cropping, bedazzling, sprucing, or painting up your favorite duds! We have shade, sewing supplies, outfit ideas, and tunes to carry you through your week.

places.name: Cold Yogis
places.desc:
Cold Yogis exist to awaken terrestrial spirit, creative life force and ancestral resiliency by wilfully disrupting the status quo and immersing into the true self! 

We offer workshops for breathwork, cold exposures, brain over body techniques, verbal liberation, yoga and tantra to increase health, self awareness, and consciousness. We host playa's most epic Ecstatic Dances.

If comfort is what you're looking for then the Squad's couch swings were made for you. The 'Bo_b Squad' hopes to see you in the cosmic wastes.

places.name: PLAYA 54

But it doesn't always turn out the way you planned and sometimes things get burnt!

Welcome to our wild and whimsical dancefloor in the shade, where the vibes are as sexy as they are hilarious! Picture a vibrant space filled with young, adventurous souls ready to unleash their inner party animal. plop! is a playground of creativity, featuring DJs spinning the hottest house & techno beats that will keep you dancing until the sun goes down.

Costumes are a must here - think playful

places.name: Groove Oasis
places.desc: Groove Oasis is your refuge in the dusty desert to rest or move your body. We are hosting dance workshops and parties throughout the week so check the playa schedule and come get your groove on!

places.name: Siren's Cove
places.desc:
A veteran group of Burning Man friends that have gathered over the years. We have been on many adventures across the world to Rejoice in the wondrous village that is created annually in the high desert dry lake bed.

A bunch of Land lubbing Unicorn, Pony lovers and for Water lovers, Mermaids and Aquatic animals.

places.name: Mutant Ninja Burners
places.desc: Are you looking for a place to kick up your dusty boots or maybe somewhere to warm up during the cold night? At Mutant Ninja Burners when you cross our sewer rat picket fence you're one of us! Don a headband, dance and groove to some wubs. Learn some sick nunchuck skillz. Warm yourself by the fire pits. You'll be rewarded with friendship, acceptance and a hot slice of pizza if you come by during o

places.name: Zeniza
places.desc: A warm pocket of ritual, music, and hospitality where strangers become companions. By day, we gather for mate ceremonies and guided mezcal tastings rooted in storytelling, curiosity, and connection. By night, we open the space for shared celebration with music, food, drinks, and a welcoming energy that invites people to linger. Come by to reset, connect, and leave with a new story.

places.name: Matcha Mama
places.desc: A daytime oasis serving handcrafted matcha lattes and meaningful connection. Stop by for a refreshing drink made to order, then settle into our shaded "Spill the Tea" lounge for conversation, reflection, or simply a moment of rest. With rotating flavors and a calm, welcoming atmosphere, this is a space to slow down and be present. Whether you stay briefly or linger a while, you're invited to conne

places.name: LEGENDARY Playground of the Gods
places.desc: The Legendary Playground of the Gods is a place for learning, authentic connection, and celebrating life. This is a place to remember that we are all Divine, Infinite & Immortal beings simply wearing the disguise of being human. Come and find an oasis from the desert, find rest in the shade, get frozen treats and feast on a week of inspired offerings in workshops, classes, music, and entertainment

places.name: Astral Lab
places.desc:
Enjoy a different sound on the playa this year. Immerse yourself in psychedelic trance soundscapes that blur the lines of party and ceremony. 

Astral Project with us in our interactive musical playground. 

All beings, All hours, All welcome.

places.name: Sakenoma
places.desc: High class lounge with bowling (leave your pedo billionaires at home). Providing a 4 star SAKE experience

places.name: NYC Deli
places.desc:
NYC Deli will be be serving Seinfeld-esque laughs and scrumptious New York Deli breakfast food 10am-12pm Monday through Saturday during the Burn. Bacon Egg and Cheese is most popular but we also have vegan, veggie, kosher and gluten Free breakfast sandwich options too! Coffee and water served. Like last year: there is an air conditioned public picnic area to enjoy your meal! 

In addition to the f

places.name: Janky Barge
places.desc: Janky Barge is an art car and all the people who made it. We cruise around the desert and have fun and play music we like. You should get on! We'll give you a ride to wherever we were already going.

places.name: Camp Fucking Magical
places.desc: Nestled in the quiet city street, our cozy camp is a haven of relaxation and connection. At its center, a giant cuddle pit swing invites visitors to sink into plush cushions and gently sway under the open sky, offering a peaceful escape from the noise and hustle of the outer city. Nearby, an enchanting bar glows with soft, colorful lights, serving drinks and innovative food delights. The camp's se

places.name: Book Club
places.desc: Book Club is proud to open its doors to serve the citizens of Black Rock City. Join us in the evening for shenanigans, whimsy, and the slowest service you'll find on any side of the playa. Bring a book, read one of ours and get comfy for a while

places.name: Hodge Podge
places.desc:
Hodge Podge - Come chill in our cafe. Come sip on espresso drink! Bring your own milk and we will make you a latte. 

Sporadic horse racing, doodling, and poetry fights.

places.name: Camp Darling
places.desc: Our camp's mission and mantra is to provide a space for decadent, wine-soaked, slightly feral joy. Come enjoy allergen-friendly charcuterie and wine in our shaded picnic space while connecting, sharing stories, enjoying the sunset with old and/or new friends, and keeping it gay. A bacchanal of frivolity, deliciousness, and delight. It's camp, darling.

places.name: Joie de Vivre
places.desc:
At Joie de Vivre, we're all about bringing the joy — even when the dust is thick and the tacos are hotter than the weather. 

Swing by in the morning for a rotating mix of movement, writing, or a card reading. Stick around for Taco Tuesday (yes, it's real), and spin the Wheel of Feels — our 24/7 interactive art piece — for a little unexpected magic.

places.name: Cosmic Llama
places.desc:
The Cosmic Llama Guardians are sworn to protect the ancient secrets of the Dali Llama lineage. The Cosmic Llamas have been charged with creating the highest vibrations of Harmony & Resonance?Without our camp offering beats, music, rhythmic dance (and llama puns)?the Cosmos would fall dangerously out of balance! 

In the whimsical world of Cosmic Llamas, every step resonates with rhythm, every word

places.name: Uli Baba & the Horny Thieves
places.desc:
The Finest Flesh Market in Black Rock City! 

In addition to the Ten Principles, our guiding inspiration is hospitality. We are always honored to serve our guests, even while subjecting them to cruel humiliation, voluntary servitude, and wanton drunkenness. Our gorgeous Moroccan tent is lushly furnished with wall-to-wall rugs, benches, and more pillows than you can count. Ours is a hard-working gr

places.name: fruitPOP
places.desc: Founded in 2019, fruitPOP is a LGBTQ-centered theme camp dedicated to radical self-expression, inclusivity, and pure, unfiltered queer joy. We create a vibrant, consent-driven space where playful absurdity meets delightful connection. Whether you're a longtime fruity member or a first-time guest, you're part of our ever-evolving, radically welcoming community. Join us, participate, and let's make

places.name: Shitty Wood
places.desc: We (sometimes) have wood. We burn. Established 2007.

places.name: Next Year on Luna
places.desc: We explore the question: as the shifting systems around us shape our experiences and our lives, what does it mean to maintain our essential humanity and ultimately to remain, or become, ourselves?

places.name: Snack Shack
places.desc: Home of The World Famous Black Rock City Hotdog Eating Contest. Floggin' and Doggin' since 2022

places.name: PlovKraft
places.desc: We cook delicious PLOV and serve it together with crazy music on the UFO stage!

places.name: Nudibranch
places.desc: Mutant vehicle support camp with radical inclusion in mind.

places.name: Pink Heart
places.desc:
Pink Heart welcomes all Burners with open arms and open hearts! Whether you're seeking refreshment, connection, or a moment of reflection, our camp is here to nourish your body, mind, and spirit. Rehydrate with ice-cold water, indulge in our beloved vegan coconut ice cream (served Tuesday and Wednesday from 1—4 PM), or unwind with soothing buffer massages at our Vibration Station.

Find your way h

places.name: Harmonic Convergence Camp
places.desc: Come by for our Welcome Pumaccinos on Monday or Farewell Pumaccinos after the Temple Burn. And if you're looking for a good party before the Man Burn, then stop by our College Football Tailgate & Viewing Party. And we will do Group Hands-On Energy Healings on Tuesday and Thursday mornings...we can teach you how to do it.

places.name: MindShark
places.desc: Stay out of Mindshark, we're glad to have you! We serve questionable drinks with confidence, blast music you didn't ask for, and light up the night with fire and LED absurdity. While you are staying out of MindShark you may participate and spectate as brave souls attempt our infamous bar games, flow with our LED dome, or trigger columns of flames to the beat of the music. Equal parts bar, art piec

places.name: Atlantis
places.desc: Returning from the dust with mezcal, myth, and music. Our lounge is open 24/7. Two DJ parties to incite dance rituals. By day: tea, meditation, and rest. By night: light, rhythm, and strange delights. Come curious. Stay so long that you forget why you came.

places.name: Do Baskets Dream
places.desc: We are the art support camp for the "Do Baskets Dream on Shore or Sea" art piece on playa!

places.name: The Pleasure Dairy
places.desc: Finally, what you've been waiting for! A Burning Man Camp that reimagines the little-known historic phenomenon of pleasure dairies! Think Marie Antoinette but in the Wild West. A place where you can never have too many cows or cow puns. At high noon be udderly refreshed by dairy-alternative craft cocktails at our bar, The Tits, and spend some time in the shade nourishing your connections at our me

places.name: Camp Seem to Leave
places.desc: Your sticky home away from home. We humbly welcome you, and the dusty pile of tetanus you rode in on. Drop by for a life-changing cocktail & leave with a side quest.

places.name: My Favorite Things
places.desc: When the dust hits, we turn to our favorite things?cooling, comforting, and slightly questionable. Stop by for a reset, a little delight, and maybe something you'll pretend you didn't love as much as you did.

places.name: Drink and Drive-In
places.desc: At our camp we condone drinking and driving-in to enjoy a movie and a drink with us! We have chairs, and games, and whit. If you've got nothing else to do, and you've had a few too many, PULL UP.

places.name: Nipple Crime
places.desc: Nipple crime is a Reno based theme camp dedicated to memorable experiences. Come have a drink at our extensive home-brewed bar. Friday's Sensual Hotdog eating contest is our biggest event and won't disappoint. We are mostly a day camp but often have small parties well into the morning.

places.name: Venice Red Light
places.desc: A roaming tribe of artists, musicians, and delightful weirdos building a playground of sound, art, and human connection. From deep sonic journeys in our dome to unexpected encounters in our lounge, we create a space where strangers become friends (or lovers) and nights stretch into sunrise.

places.name: Shuttlecocks
places.desc: We're bringing Badminton back. Our playa court is open from 3pm into the evening from Monday to Thursday for pick up play. Come on by, grab a racquet and have a go! Don't miss our Tuesday BADminton cheeky happy hour at the Outer Lounge and Thursday evening tournament where you can challenge your fellow burners. Whether you're showing off your killer smash, whacking a few birdies, or relaxing with

places.name: Jail of Hedone
places.desc: A lush red lounge and stage devoted to Hedone, the Goddess of Sensual Pleasure. Guests are "charged" with ridiculous crimes, tried in a theatrical court, and sentenced to spin our giant Wheel of Fate for playful, consensual "punishments". Expect the finest DJs, engaging theatrical performances, a misted dance floor, along with a stripper pole, a comfy sea of couches and pillows, and a bar serving

places.name: Kidsville
places.hometown: Kidsville honestly does not have a home town.  We started on playa with families from all over.  We are truly from everywhere, however if we have to pick a hometown: Our Mayor is from Austin, TX.
places.desc: Kidsville is a playful family village where young Burners and their grownups can find adventure, community, and a touch of magic on playa. With trampolines, playgrounds, kid friendly treats, daily activities, and plenty of opportunities for fun, Kidsville is a welcoming home for families with Burners under 18.

places.name: Vietnamese Iced Coffee Experience
places.desc: VICE is an all inclusive, lgbtq-centric Burning Man Theme Camp returning for the 24th consecutive year to offer cool icy beverages during the heat of the day as well as several other activities for our fellow participants. We encourage diversity, participation, and acceptance and welcome new members from all locales and walks of life.

places.name: NumbSkulls
places.desc: Support camp for NumbSkull

places.name: Drawn Inn
places.desc: Drawn Inn is a studio space and lounge where you are both the artist, and the art. Come flex those artistic muscles at our Figure Drawing classes and even try your hand at being one of our models! We will have open studio hours. And, themed events where we offer whimsical props, body paint and creative atmosphere to help you become your most inspired self.

places.name: Rabbit Hole
places.desc: It's whatever you want it to be!

places.name: dust & stars
places.desc:
WE WELCOME ALL WHO DARE. this is dust & star's twelfth year as a theme cult. that's right: we're a cult. since the dawn of us, we've donned black robes and warned other burners the endless night was on its way. 

to tell you the truth, we're starting to think the night not actually be endless. ln fact, the horizon is getting brighter...and from what we've glimpsed, there's a breathtaking new dawn

places.name: Maison Phi
places.desc:
Maison Phi is your beautifully chaotic oasis in the dust where hydration, pancakes, yoga, and late-night dance floors all coexist in perfect imbalance.

By day, come get revived at our Cucumber Water Station, reset with yoga, cool off with popsicles, or hang at our card games and pancake mornings.

By evening, we serve up our iconic Dirty Chicken Martini Soup and roll out for golden hour art car r

places.name: Mystopia
places.desc: Step out of the sun-scorched wonderland into our cool haven. It's an icy oasis, an ice cream paradise, and a sanctuary for all. We welcome everyone: friends, partners, parents, children, individuals of any race, orientation and identity. Stop by our burner family and experience the rainbow of diversity. Come play with us, sit down and watch some drag/burlesque, dance with a stranger or simply rela

places.name: Hotel Lobby
places.desc: With a lavish chandelier, bellhop service, concierge desk, a lux hotel bar, and a buzzing karaoke lounge, you'll be treated to 5-star service and a dusty bev in a welcoming and weird Hotel Lobby.

places.name: Udder Nonsense
places.desc: Something mysterious has appeared on the playa. A herd of cows, extraterrestrial, or possibly escaped from Fly Ranch, has set up camp, and they want you. places.name: The Den
places.desc: That magical place where you can explore fun and play, where you can connect deeply with a person and never see them again, where you can talk philosophy, politics, science... or just be horny! Or just rela

places.name: Religious As Fuck
places.desc: A mix of Christian clergy, lay people and friends who want to bring a wide open welcome to BRC citizens, as they wish. Our mission is to offer affirmation, blessing, and spiritual support to Burner folx through Christian sacraments, ritual, prayer and conversation. We provide decomodified and non-judgy Christian spiritual practice and hospitality.

places.name: 8-bit Bunny
places.desc: Our steam sauna is open every day. Sweet out the dust and leave cleaner than you have ever been on playa. Feeling adventurous? Spin the wheel at our bar for a drink. Rabbit ears encouraged, but not required.

places.name: MUSE (Maenad University)
places.desc: The Maenad University for the Study of the Esoteric (M.U.S.E.) is a tribute to the deity Dionyus and offers a temple space for offerings as well as for our interactivity which ranges from spiritual to silly. places.name: Illuminaughty
places.desc: Look up and follow the LED Ball to Camp Illuminaughty where naughty meets light. Join us on Tuesday and Thursday from 9pm until 2am! DJs will help save your life in front of our brilliant 18' Penrose Tile Wall. Drop by any other time for pictures with the art, perfect shade and drinks from the always going bar!

places.name: Black Rock Academy
places.desc:
Black Rock Academy is a collective of artists and crafts-people. The collective works together to create art through different mediums year round through community engagement. We are often approached at Camp Black Rock Academy with the question of, "So what do you guys teach?"

places.name: It's Only Natural
places.desc: Our camp offers a safe and inclusive environment for individuals wishing to participate in naturism. The space is fully enclosed, shielding participants from cell phones, cameras, and onlookers in the city. Inside, you will find a communal gathering area, with games, music, and a daily cocktail hour. We provide a friendly, non-sexualized setting for anyone wishing to experience nude recreation.

places.name: The G-Spot & Sloth Sinema
places.desc: Can you find the G-Spot? We are your favorite neighborhood dive bar. Come thirsty, leave happy! New for 2024 we are shifting to an evening offering and opening the Sloth Sinema. Join us for a chill evening of great movies, themed cocktails, and of course, shenanigans! Family-friendly matinees included. Already have plans for the evening? Come by in the morning for "Saturday" morning cartoons and m

places.name: Native Tongues
places.desc:
A Native Tongue speaks to the frequency we all share, a common way of communicating with love, empathy & respect. An acknowledgment of the humanity we recognize in each other.
And also a kick ass rap collective from the 90's!

places.name: Owl and the Pussycat
places.desc: We are a small but mighty group of folx whose camp is a safe, welcoming environment for all Burners. We not only value physical comfort as seen by our cozy lounge and dining space, but emotional comfort to promote connection, conversation and reflection with our fellow Burners. places.name: Last Camp Sitting
places.desc: Is it a porto, is a portal? Only those who look closely will know!

places.name: Temple Camp
places.desc: We are the support camp for Temple of the Moon, this year's official Burning Man Temple. We are a multinational crew of artists, builders, creators and supporters who have spent all of 2026 bringing this temple to life for our community. We welcome everyone to stop by and learn more about the process of designing and building the temple, and we'd love to hear your thoughts and stories.

places.name: A Shack of Sit
places.desc:
Do you feel like belting out a karaoke song or letting out your frustrations in our rage cage (uncaged)? Are you looking for a great spot to sit, grab some cold water, and watch the world go by while getting your nails painted, moisturizing your face, and enjoying a percussive massage? Are you looking for the Mensa Camp?
Come visit A Shack of Sit; where sit happens. We will be waiting for you in S

places.desc: Come by and enjoy our homemade Pickle Back Juice at our Pickle Back Bar. Come through our Saloon Doors in Space, mosey on up to bar, throw down a Pickle Back! Then, for the daring, jump on Gherkin our famous Bucking Pickle for the buck of your life!

places.name: Playa Piano Bar and Lounge
places.desc:
Playa Piano Bar and Lounge will be featuring live collaborative musical performance along with refreshing beverages every afternoon except Friday and Saturday. Come by Tuesday for Tutu Tuesday Tacos and Tutus from 12-2pm
Come by SaturdayFor Pizza Pockets and Music from 12-2
Cocoa and music at sunset Monday to Friday at 8 PM

places.name: New Desert Outpost
places.desc: We are an eclectic, antique outpost for wanderers and those seeking adventure.

places.name: Stimulation Station
places.desc: Dive into a little oasis for your nervous system at Stimulation Station. Slip on a mask and let the world fade as we guide you Monday through Friday, 12pm to 3pm, through a consent based sensory reset. Expect soothing touch with gentle tools and scratch therapy plus calming soundscapes designed to help you drop in and breathe again. Spot our bold front scaffolding and hot pink Stimulation sign glo

places.name: Wok Paper Scissors
places.desc: Welcome to Wok Paper Scissors! Here in Sizzle City you battle for your stir fry. Come one, come all to Wok Paper Scissors, serving stir fry on the playa daily. To get your hands on a bowl of our delicious delights, you must first win a game of rock-paper-scissors! Do you have what it takes when noodles are at stake?

places.name: Moonlight Collective
places.desc: The Moonlight Collective is part of the Temple Crew hub and will be supporting the Temple of the Moon build. Come visit our bar and have a chat with the Entity. Meet the team that designed the temple this year and share your stories.

places.name: Parley
places.desc:
Parley is your dedicated conversation camp. Come "Parley" with us during our daily facilitated events or drop in during the day for adhoc conversations on your topic of your choice.

places.name: Pickle Joint
places.desc:
Downtown Black Rock City's favorite magical little hole in the wall. Serving our world famous Pickle-Tini Cocktail since? errp? too long.
Let's say well over a decade. Always a sumptuous groove on our dance floor?.or maybe a Led Zeppelin Kazoo orchestra.

places.name: Square One
places.desc: A diverse group united in creating large-scale art through efficient and sustainable designs, inspiring individuals and other camps to burn stronger. places.name: Playa Circuit Boogie
places.desc: Here at Playa Circuit Boogie we use circuits and science to spark ideas and bring strangers together, all while jamming out to groovy tunes and enjoying a cold beverage from our bar. places.name: Hookahdome
places.desc: Enter our silk draped, plush, cushioned, lantern-lit, air-conditioned dome to be whisked away into an oasis from the dust and heat. Let our loving attendants ensure your comfort while we serve you house made organic shisha and tea. Be entertained by a variety of intimate world music and dance performances taking place on the center carpet. Wednesday-Sunday evenings, our outdoor courtyard, illumina

places.name: Aah Wonder
places.desc: Offers Thai coconut bites (Kanom Krok) and Thai iced tea inspired by our members' favorite experiences traveling around the world. While waiting for your fresh off the griddle treat, step into our shaded lounge space with rugs, pillows, and cool mist fans. There, you can relax and enjoy connecting with new people and playing conversational and hands-on games. All ages welcome!

places.name: Camp Safari
places.desc: Determine your fate with a spin of the Safari Wheel. Photo ops, animal hunts, and other dusty games

places.name: A Transformation Station
places.desc:
Explore, Engage, Evolve: Transformation at A Transformation Station.

Step into a space where grounded healing, interactive experiences, and playful experimentation come together. By day, join workshops in breathwork, meditation, movement, and conscious technology, or sign up for one-on-one sessions inside our climate-controlled sanctuary. By night, engage in music, salons, and participatory gathe

places.name: Shoturanga
places.desc: We believe true connectedness isn't found in perfect zen?it's forged in the shaky, sweaty, deeply questionable life choices that happen somewhere between chaturanga and "why is this still plank?" This is yoga for the rest of us: the ones with wandering minds, tight hamstrings, and a running internal monologue that would definitely get us kicked out of a silent retreat. And nothing says connectedne

places.name: Mystic
places.hometown: Bay Area + Los Angeles CA + Denver, CO + New York, NY
places.desc:
Mystic is a legendary theme camp with 20+ years of magic in Black Rock City ? a vibrant sanctuary of interactive art, transcendent music, and soul-expanding workshops.
BY DAY: Dive into our Visionary Speaker Series, Healing Modalities, and Mind-Body Workshops inside the iconic Mystic Theater and Mystic Temple.
BY NIGHT: Lose yourself in fire dancers, visionary musicians, and boundary-pushing artis

places.desc: To deviate positively is to play with the rules, reimagine the future, build new realities, and break what no longer serves. It starts small: a question, an experiment, a new way of relating - that quietly reorganizes what's possible between us and around us.

places.name: The Institute
places.desc: The Institute of higher yearning invites the dusty wanderer to expand their mind into the bottomless pit of knowledge and exploration.

places.name: Lunar Disco
places.desc: Embrace the cosmic elements in our electrifying dance and party spaces, with interstellar beats and mesmerizing ambience. Connect with fellow stargazers in our ceremonial space, honoring the celestial bodies and the shared human experience. Embark on an otherworldly adventure at Lunar Disco.

places.name: HAVANA NIGHTS
places.desc: Experience the essence of a vibrant Latin dance party infused with the relaxed vibe of Miami. Encircled by palm trees, our spacious, shaded dance floor beckons. Relax on our plush, elevated chill pads or sway in hammocks. Savor the night with bottomless, hand-muddled frozen mojitos as world-class DJs deliver an electrifying mix of Cuban and Latin rhythms. Immerse yourself in culture with daily dan

places.name: Fauxliage
places.desc: Our fake greenhouse offers a temporary refuge from the harsher elements of the playa. Come take a break in our cool misted space and relax to a nice soundscape. Stick around for some spontaneous DJ sets! At night, look for our 11' LED sign, colorful up lights, silhouetted plants! We'll also have an interactive 20 foot circular LED art piece that has some custom low resolution panels that light up

places.name: Ready Playa One
places.desc: A world that we dream up, believe in, and step curiously into, together in Black Rock City. Each day is an adventure to expand our minds, deepen human connection, and creatively challenge the status quo's of the world that we believe in changing.

places.name: The Fountain (of youth)
places.desc:
A longevity-focused camp at BM where we celebrate life and coordinate to fight aging & death.

Our gifts to the playa are LongeviTEA, our signature teahouse and the Rejuvenating IV Lounge.

Whether you're seeking a soothing cup

places.name: Yellow Balloon
places.desc: A clean and sober camp, offering a space for fun, connection, and wellness without the influence of substances. We host daily AA meetings, wellness events like yoga and breathwork, and interactive art experiences designed to uplift and engage. Our camp is a vibrant community of burners who love to have a great time while staying clean and sober throughout the burn. We welcome all Burners to attend

places.name: Dr. Carl's Collection of Depts.

places.name: FUN-DO BAR
places.desc: Looking to get melty while having a booty shaking good time?! Look no further than Fun-Do Bar! places.desc: At Helioz, we worship the Sun god. To honor our god, we roast delicious animals and share them with all guests. Come by in the late afternoon and evening for some tasty treats, and drink a sun-god libation.

places.name: Dreamery
places.desc:
Dreamery is a camp to discover, share and experience dreams. It is an interactive space to read and write dreams and fantasies, happy or scary, random and crazy, sensual or sad.

What dream would you ask for if you could?
If you could go anywhere in a dream, where would it be?

At Dreamery, you might also meet someone special. You can see if you want to hang out for just a bit or maybe become life

places.name: Serenity Now
places.desc: An oasis in a world of dust. Serenity Now is one of the playa's oldest coffee shops, and for a good reason.

places.desc: We could be anything—including a dusty saloon run by Giants, come by for our nightly Sunset Socials for a variety of offerings of music, food, and drinks! Our saloon doors are open 24 hours, stop by anytime to see if the bar is open or just to rest your weary boots. A variety of workshops will be happening throughout the week, roll on through and see what we're up to!

places.name: Liquid Spankuary
places.desc: Dusty, parched, and feeling a little too well-behaved? Come get refreshed and red-cheeked at Liquid Spankuary! places.name: Hard as a Rock
places.desc: A rag-tag bunch of geologists with a passion for sharing geology - including the geology of the Black Rock Desert! Join our geologists for rock talks, get creative with rock painting. Dig up your best rock puns and strike fools gold and other rockin' gifts!

places.name: The Shrimp Ranch

places.name: Alchemy Stop
places.desc: Alchemy Stop is a dusty sanctuary for anyone to enjoy a quiet musical retreat with a cold hand-made limoncello in hand. Look for our open bar - we will be welcoming you with open arms.

Welcome to Water Temple a sanctuary of serenity, connection, and renewal in the heart of the playa. We're a theme camp dedicated to holding space for hydration, healing, and human connection through elemental experiences and desert hospitality.

Cold, Kombucha (because hydration is sacred)
Guided meditations & sound baths
Shade, chill zones, and high-pressure misting

Pull up a bar stool at Flanagan's Pub - open day and night - for a refreshing beverage. Cozy up on one of our couches beneath the ample and breezy shade structure. Let loose on the dance floor. We're a relaxed and fun-loving crowd from all over - San Francisco, Tahoe, Reno

places.name: Nose Fish
places.desc:
Come get coffee from an undisclosed appendage of the Nose Fish itself Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday mornings and stay for the music! This year we're giving away cookies!

Hella Halo-Halo Thursday 2-4:30 during bike repair - come get a refreshing Filipino shave ice treat! Don't forget your cup or bow

places.name: Jungle Oddity

places.name: BigFrankEnergy
places.desc: Come get a hot dog. places.name: Backstage
places.desc: Backstage is an interactive electronic music camp built as a rotating audience-to-artist-to-crew ritual. Part social music installation and part anti-spectator experience, it invites guests into a structured participation loop of backstage creation, onstage performance, and front of house support. Participants create a track in a guided music studio behind the stage, hear it come alive on stage, t

places.name: CrazyCamera & Christmas Every Day

places.name: French Maid Brigade
places.desc: The French Maids are a playful, meaningful, health and wellness camp that is excited to offer Ayurvedic Massages, Scented Oils, Yoga, Breathing, Happiness and Art workshops to express any Burners creative skills...Come chill and add to your experience on playa with the MAIDS!

places.name: Gaian Airship
places.desc: An immersive journey into the thriving future. We play a game to create a unifying vision of the thriving future around the Time, Water, Fire, Air and Earth elements.

places.name: HIGHKU
places.desc:
Push through our glowing torii gate and drop into a solar-fueled zen oasis humming on pure sun power; no roar of generators, just clean, quiet relief. Mist-kissed shade with rippling silk skies and angled tarps welcomes you to endless icy lemonade, coconut water, and a gentle train that chugs surprise gifts...cooling bandanas, glow bits, playa vitamins; straight to your dusty lap. 

Sink into the

places.name: Reverbia
places.desc:
An All Live Music Camp with 4 stages, including: The Cosmic Dome (LED interactive) The Jam and Teahouse, The Phoenix Rising Shade Stage, and Reverbia Main Stage. 
Reverbia features Daily: Calm Inside (breathe, Stretch) ,Live Music Yoga in the Morning...Dance Workshops, Open Mic/ Songwriter Showcase, Concerts in the Shade, Reverbia Classical Music Sunsets and Live Nights, The Reverbia Childrens' Ho

places.name: Cicadia
places.desc: This nature and bug themed camp is buzzing with excitement and fun. The sweet sounds of music will draw you in like bugs to nectar. You can rest in the shaded nooks and comfy seats, quench your thirst with cold electrolytes, or dance the night away on the beautifully lit dancefloor.

places.name: Toxic Disco Clam
places.desc: In the default world, the Toxic Disco Clam is a real aquatic creature. It uses its luminous lips to attract passing fish... and then it dazes them with acidic snot. We're pretty much the same: we draw you in with dazzling lights and entertaining activities, we ply you with our intoxicating beverages, and we hope you never leave.

places.name: Kentucky Fried Camp
places.desc: Kentucky Fried Campers only need one spice, and that's the spice of life. If you wanna taste it, join us any time of day or night. We begin each morning with the best hot breakfast on playa; a shot of Kentucky bourbon served with a fried baloney sandwich. Afternoons you'll find us relaxing in our Olde Kentucky Dome, crafting, napping, match-making, and lots of watching the Black Rock City whirled

places.name: LAF Lazy-Ass Fuckers
places.desc: Come walk through the history of Playa SWAG at The Playa Artifact Museum! We provide a look into past pins, posters, tickets and more, highlighting decades of creativity at the Burn. We host workshops with new artists and friends from years past. All are welcome!

places.name: ReEntry Station
places.desc:
A calm, low stimulation space designed for participants returning from deep playa. As you make your way back into the city, step into a shaded environment offering cold water, electrolytes, and a place to pause and reset.

We provide a soft landing from the intensity of the playa. No loud music, no pressure, just a welcoming space to reorient, cool down, and reconnect before continuing your journe

places.name: Dusty Delight
places.desc: Come cool off with fresh playa-made ice cream while dancing to our incredible melodic techno DJs spinning atop our sexy art car Double-D! Join the festivities Tuesday-Friday 1-5pm.

places.name: Camp VRC
places.desc: Camp VRC is about capturing and sharing the Burning Man experience beyond the playa by means of immersive 360 D virtual reality (VR) footage. Lose yourself in past year's VR experiences or jump in and help us build a global network to carry the impact beyond the playa. Monday to Saturday, 3-5pm, at the yellow short schoolbus. Also, you might find us POP-UP, to show footage, at other busy events th

places.name: GDI's - Gawd Damn Independents
places.desc: We're the GDI's (Gawd Damn Independents) and we're all working for the Man. We're Nevada Burners, plus one gawd damn Canuck - all with "Playa MacGyver" skills. places.name: Mimosa
places.desc: Hey you, yes you our dear friend! I know what you want, or I would say even need. A fresh, cold MIMOSA. Please step by our bar where we will get you what you need.

places.name: Mary E's Lavender Hand Wash
places.desc: Come feel the Lavender Love and wash the day's playa away! A moment of tranquility is sacred in the desert, and we are here to honor that moment with a lovely hand wash & hand massage, leaving you feeling relaxed and happy!

places.name: Fucking Joe Camp
places.desc: Welcome to Fucking Joe Camp! Where everybody knows your name, and we're always glad you came!

places.name: ClusterF*ck United
places.desc: Dust, Sun, Booze, Bikes, Night, and Noise?it's a ClusterF*ck out there and that's exactly what you'll find here: a ClusterF*ck of activity where chaos meets collaboration in the heart of the playa! Our camp is a vibrant and diverse community of Burners from around the globe, coming together to celebrate the spirit of Burning Man in our own unique and unconventional ways. Look for our brightly-lit

places.name: Daydream
places.desc: Welcome to Daydream, a sanctuary in Black Rock City designed for radical inclusion, creativity, and connection. Step into our Dreamers' Lounge, an immersive space to relax, recharge, and meet fellow Burners away from the chaos of the playa. Start your mornings at our coffee bar and interactive talks, then linger in the lounge or cuddle puddle for spontaneous social and creative interactions. In th

places.name: Spoonful of Friends
places.desc:
A camp built around the simple idea that sharing a meal can turn strangers into something closer. We create thoughtful, beautifully hosted dining experiences that bring people together. Long tables, warm lighting, music that invites you in, and conversations that linger.

Our camp is a place to connect, and participate. Some come to cook, some to serve, some to host, and some simply to be held by

Midday Reset, and an evening social hour that creates an easy space for people 
to meet and unwind. Our main attraction is a tall oiled slide that invites 
participants to let go and play like kids again, with camp members on hand to 
keep everything safe and fun. On select afternoons we gift authentic fried 
pizza made fres

places.name: Fantastica Music Healing Camp
places.desc: Reset with us in a space where the magical sounds of live guitar gently guide you into relaxation and inner balance. Here, you can pause, release tension, and simply be. Our camp creates an atmosphere of calm, comfort, and mindful presence. Open to all who seek restoration and a deeper connection with themselves.

places.name: Camp XUZA
places.desc:
Home of XUZA Art Car
Every Night XUZA will be out on the prowl, seeking out Art installations to host parties and more.

places.name: Fjörgyn's Lair
places.desc:
The Viking Longboat was a potent symbol of life, livelihood, one's journey through life, the afterlife, and was used by the Norse for transport, in trade, in warfare, and as a burial vessel for centuries.
Fjorgyn is a personification of earth in Norse mythology, and the mother of the thunder god Thor, the son of Odin.

places.name: Camp Questionmark
places.desc: The age of questioning is here! Celebrating creativity & music born from the playa. Bring us your questions and we will give you more back )?(

places.name: Inflatable Wildlife
places.desc: Inflatable Wildlife is the premiere destination for all indigenous inflatables of the playa. See you in the dust.

places.desc: A vibrant community bringing flavor, music, and warmth to Playa. Sharing our culture through food and connection. Our chill lounge offers a welcoming space with good vibes and great conversations. Everyone is invited to stop by, enjoy a meal, and experience our hospitality. Come as you are?leave as part of the Chivo Loco family!

places.name: Sozo Experience

Best known for our sunrise to midday dancing revelry: more Bubbles and Bass makes the playa a magical place!

places.desc: Welcome to Favela ArtCar & Camp, inspired by the spirit of resilience, community, and creativity found in Brazil's most vibrant slum neighborhoods. places.name: Dark Heart
places.desc:
Morning community dance followed by small, intimate heart-share pods? Incredible afternoon expansive workshops? Sunset rituals? Fire art? Fire DANCE?!? Nightly temple celebrations of intimacy and joy? Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!
