places.name: Hush Hush Pony Barn
places.desc: Hush Hush Pony Barn is exciting to bring two offerings to playa: Our beloved Mutant Vehicle made out of reclaimed fence board and our interactivity Gossip & Guillotines. They say you'll lose your head at Burning Man! Come see what the rumor mill and the gallery are all chatting about.

places.name: Beaverton
places.desc: Camp Beaverton is an intentional, experimental, and experiential Burning Man community theme camp and a legacy sapphic nonprofit organization. Not queer? No fear! We're straight friendly! We are a group of queer women/trans/genderqueer/lesbian/bisexual/heterosexual/etc... or folks who are simply as wayward as the playa is dusty. We celebrate sexuality, self exploration, and respect for one's journ

places.name: Rogue Nation (SEAWeed)
places.desc: Ever wonder what happens when light listens? Light Echoes is an interactive LED wall that responds to your movement, sound, and presence, transforming you into a living paintbrush. Stop by during the day for a shady lounge to rest your dusty bones, or come back after dark to see the wall come alive. Join one of our workshops to create your own digital art and add it to the wall's growing collectio

places.name: Mindwerk
places.desc: Come to Mindwerk and ride our slide!! Relax in our shady dome and enjoy a Pomerosegasm, the most delicious and refreshing cocktail in Black Rock City! Climb up to our viewing platform where you can behold a 360 degree view of our beautiful metropolis. Exhilarating egress is provided by a convenient slide. It's been called "just the right amount of sketchy" by satisfied customers. And its polymer s

places.name: From Mars With Love
places.desc: Home of the Serendipity Mars Rover

places.name: Nordic Paradise
places.desc: Where cold-brew coffee meets an exciting bar and cafe. Explore workshops for body and mind, dance to music, and chill out in style. Join our Qurious Viking party, celebrating all gender expressions. It's an unforgettable experience waiting for you. Welcome to Nordic Paradise!

places.name: TRANSCEND
places.desc: A place to celebrate the sound of electronic music in all of its forms, a place to "TRANCSEND" mind, body and soul using any beat per minute you can imagine. Join us for this musical journey on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons!

places.name: Imagine Nation Art Lounge
places.desc: Remember how you felt when you were drawing on kitchen tables and living room floors? Tap back into a state of mind that embodied the purist creative version of yourself! We encourage our guests to tap into their childhood imagination again through the medium of art, especially drawing and colouring.

places.name: Organic Fruit & Veggie Camp
places.desc: The finest fruits and veggies to wet your whistle and soothe your soul. Come have a snack and a chat and reset your mind and body.

places.name: Black Rock Piano Lounge
places.desc: Black Rock Piano Lounge is the place to come and share your talent with a friendly audience. We bring great musicians to the playa but build our lounge for that spontaneous moments where the perfect vocals are combined with the best tuned pianos on the playa. Lets make some beautiful music together.

places.name: Nova Heaven
places.desc: The crew that has created Nova Heaven for the past two years are gathering together to bring "Let There Be Light", a new art installation to playa. Come by and say "Shalom". We love you.

places.name: Playa Agora
places.desc: A vibrant space of connection, curiosity, and community. We host a full week of interactive workshops, coffee, and sangria, designed to spark conversation, inspire creativity, and bring people together. Come learn, share, and laugh with us as we co-create something meaningful at Burning Man 2026.

places.name: Wrongtown
places.desc:
Wrongtown is an international family reunion gathering year round at events around the globe including Burning Man which is the main event! We have members on almost every Continent and from all walks of life.

Our goal is to create a community space for our friends and family to experience the playa to its fullest. The camp works together to provide everything needed to survive on the playa inclu

places.name: Rum Amok
places.desc: Throughout the week, our shade structure transforms into a tropical bar with a communal open-air studio. We provide the drinks, the brushes and the pigment, you provide the inspiration and the playa magic. Whether you're a master painter or just looking to make a mess, your strokes will contribute to our collective camp mural.

places.name: Gender Blender
places.desc: Welcoming home our trans, non-binary, BIPOC, and gender non-conforming community on Playa!

places.name: Heart of Parkness
places.desc: A lush green oasis in the middle of the desert, open 24 hours a day, anchored by a shade tree, carpet meadow, benches and shade. There are frisbees, chessboards, cornhole, horse shoes, chess, giant connect 4, etc. We provide electronics repair services M-Tuesday and S'mores, Shots and Soul music at sunset, W-Thursday 6-9.

places.name: Moon Landing
places.desc:
Moon Landing, a celestial outpost of creativity, exploration, and radical self-expression at Burning Man. Our camp is a launchpad for dreamers, builders, and cosmic wanderers?a space where art, technology, and human connection intersect in gravity-defying ways.

Inspired by the pioneering spirit of lunar exploration, we craft immersive experiences that transport participants beyond the ordinary. W

places.name: Camp PtP - Papillio Ovum
places.desc: Art support camp for placed art installation "Papillio Ovum".

places.name: THE VEIL
places.desc: Empyrean is an immersive, walk-through theatrical experience that invites you into a mystical journey of beauty, darkness, and transformation. Step inside our atmospheric realms where living art, interactive spirit guides, and cinematic staging surround you in a story you don't just watch, you walk through. When you emerge, drift into our luminous lounge, a sanctuary to reflect, unravel, and proce

places.name: Prairie Kids
places.desc: We are the Prairie Kids, The Mutant Vehicle Support camp for the Astral Plain.

places.name: Vines Without Borders
places.desc: A chill international wine bar and lounge open afternoons and evening daily, gifting great chilled wines and snacks from around the world, served by people from around the world. We celebrate a different wine producing region daily. Great music, fun people, curated tastings and something new every day.

places.name: You Look Amazing
places.desc:
You Look Amazing is not just a camp name, but a state of mind. We LOVE each and everyone of you and want to get to know you better. 

Our camp is an oasis of wellness at Burning Man. Where mind, body, and spirit converge in a harmonious dance of rejuvenation and exploration. Nestled amidst the pulsating energy of the playa, our camp offers a sanctuary unlike any other—a haven where participants ca

places.name: Camp THREAT
places.desc: Dominating the portos for 6 years or more. Unofficial Headquarters of The Black Rock City Communist Party (BRCCP). Gonzo Decommodification Experts and Proud Purveyors of Bullshit. Sales and Service 100% Guaranteed to soothe the soul and waste the body and mind. Cold looks and warm seats. The whiskey is tolerable and the wine is worse. While supplies last. Conditions and terms apply. We are not a c

places.name: Lost + Found
places.desc: We are a diverse community, a California-based collective of dreamers, artists, adventurers, and creative doers, that loves throwing fun off-the-wall parties as much as we love connecting on deeper levels. We love to just be, we love to play, curate unique experiences, and faff about - whether it's flow, dance, music, magic, bubbles, movement, fire, food, drinks, art, live jams, deep talks, tiny t

places.name: Bubble Lounge
places.desc: A queer-forward, wildly inclusive, bar and chill zone celebrating 27 years on playa. Featuring DJ tower, interactive dance structure, vibrantly lit body wash experience, a chill lounge, and secret room (SSSH!) where you can find reprieve from the chaos. Expect music, mischief, bubbly, and a caring group of folk in equal measure.

places.name: the Garage
places.desc: Art support camp for "the Garage"

places.name: XXX-MAS
places.desc: XXXmas! A place where things are as random as a wild holiday themed camp is in a dry ancient lake bed in August where people from around the world hangout to celebrate this special time of year together. From our fully stocked pickle bar and ice cream station to 3 foot chess pieces and pictures with some guy we just met who thinks he is the real Santa Clause, this is a place you sure don't want to

places.name: Camp Cul-de-Sac
places.desc: Our Cinema runs from Sunset to Sunrise, Tuesday through Friday. Family-friendly content 8pm-10pm. Silent Films 10pm-12am. A cornucopia of the delightful and absurd from 12am-6am. A different theme every night!

places.name: Bubble Camp
places.desc: Bubbles, bubbles everywhere and drops to drink for all. Dispensing thai iced tea and cold pressed coffee for all you parched playa peeps.

places.name: Alborz
places.desc: If you find yourself parched and disoriented, listen carefully. Follow the melody and you may just stumble across camp Alborz. We'll be happy to nurture your body and soul before we send you back off to find the next adventure.

places.name: Queertirement
places.desc: Queer Retirement Community - Hang with the queer playa elders, drink lemonade, bring magic, love, and gifts and receive great wisdom.

places.name: Burning Globe
places.desc:
Thespian? Thespian-curious? Do you have lots of Thespian friends? Well, round here, we call that an "ally" If that sounds like you, come join us for a chalice-full of tomfoolery, skullduggery, swashbuckle...ery and overall merriment. Theatrics! Catharsis! Comedy! Tragedy... catch a show--or be a part of one! We'll make you a fancy cocktail after the performance...

...if you can find our bar, that

places.name: Kwalq Camp
places.desc: The Kwalq Camp mission is to help young polywogs achieve the best version of themselves by learning how to breath. Ready for the next level? Please stop by and we'll help you achieve your best froggie self.

places.name: Black Rock Brewery
places.desc: Black Rock Brewery specializes in serving home brew creations. Including dozens of varieties of beer, cider, mead, seltzer, wine and tea. We are also home to Utah Fire Tribe conclave group.

places.name: Camp Babe
places.desc: CAMP BABE is a collection of curious, universal, space-time travelers on a sparkly journey through the cosmos. Our chariot is a shooting star (hailing from the dense star nebula surrounding planet B4B3) and we come bearing wonderful and exotic gifts for the denizens of the intergalactic hub that is Black Rock City, Earth.

places.name: BMIR
places.desc:
Burning Man Information Radio (94.5 FM) is your nexus for essential information on the playa. Check BMIR for late-breaking event announcements and a melange of music. In the event of an on-site emergency, tune into BMIR for rumor-free updates and advisories to surf the storm to a sane conclusion.

Come down to BMIR from 12-5pm each day to record event and camp announcements. Or relate your encount

places.name: Burner Express Bus Depot
places.desc: Burner Express Bus Depot for arriving and departing Burner Express buses.

places.name: Census
places.desc: The Census has been collecting information about the population of Black Rock City since 2002. The results of the Census from previous years will be on display at the Census Lab on playa and published in the Population Analysis Report at https://blackrockcitycensus.org

places.name: Earth Guardians
places.desc: Earth Guardians are an outreach and communications volunteer group whose mission is to educate and inspire Burning Man participants to Leave No Trace (LNT) at the event. We can go beyond leaving "no trace" and leave instead, positive traces on the land. Come see our many bike nature and geology tours, sustainability speakers, DIY workshops, Aztec Burner dances, or volunteer training and gatherings

places.name: ESD Rampart
places.desc: Rampart is the main medical clinic staffed by  licensed medical professionals able to provide advanced care to the entire community. Doctors, nurses, paramedics, x-ray techs, lab techs and pharmacists on staff 24/7 along with ambulances and aircraft provide care at the highest level under permit from the State of Nevada.

places.name: ESD Station 3:00
places.desc: ESD Station 3 supports the Medical station at 3 & C, it is also the home to the Black Rock City Fire Department. For 25 Years "Fire Camp" has been the playa home for ourESD Fire, HazMat, Tech Rescue and medical volunteers.

places.name: ESD Station 9:00
places.desc: ESD station 9 supports the ESD Medical station at 9 & C, it also the playa home to many  ESD medical volunteers.

places.name: Fire Conclave Convergence
places.desc: Fire Conclave Convergence is where Fire Performers, Ambient Drummers, and Documentarians who will be performing in the Great Circle will be signing in and receiving procedural information. Those with a Black Rock passport can also get their passport stamped.

places.name: HOVerlandia
places.desc: Designated camping for riders of the Burner Express. All riders are welcomed to camp across the street from the bus depot in HOVerlandia. Share your love for mass transit with Burners from all over the world.

places.name: Lamplighters
places.desc: Lamplighters! Longest running performance art on Playa. Come help us help YOU! Lamplighters light the city every night of the event so YOU can get home safely. We throw a volunteer party everyday at 5pm, and light the city after that.

places.name: Media Mecca
places.desc: Media Mecca is Black Rock City's home to storytellers, journalists, and media. All media projects must register at Mecca prior to beginning in BRC.

places.name: MOOP MAP HQ
places.desc: MOOP Map HQ is Playa Restoration's home base ? part LNT response center, part history hub, part hangout. We're like a firehouse for MOOP, ready to roll out when there's an issue. It's also where you'll find past MOOP Maps, interactive displays, and friendly faces happy to chat about Leave No Trace or how to join the Resto crew!

places.name: Placement HQ
places.desc: Placement HQ is the official location of the Placement office on playa. We are at Esplanade & 5:45 - stop by to get in touch with your placers, to check in for a PEERS shift, or just to say hi!

places.name: Playa Info/VRT
places.desc:
Look for the Blue "I" in the sky near center camp!
Providing Oracles, Digital Services, Lost and Found, ASL, Health Permits and BRC Lockout and Towing Services.
Open 9am-6pm daily with limited services 8 am-11am on Sept. 2

places.name: Ranger Headquarters
places.desc: Black Rock Ranger Headquarters ? The center of Black Rock Ranger Operations. Located on the Esplanade at 6:35.

places.name: Ranger Outpost Berlin
places.desc:
Ranger Outpost Berlin - The Black Rock Ranger Station in the 3:00 sector where participants in need of assistance can
seek out the help of a friendly Black Rock Ranger. Located at 3:00 and C.

places.name: Ranger Outpost Tokyo
places.desc: Ranger Outpost Tokyo - the Black Rock Ranger station in the 9:00 sector where participants in need of assistance can seek out the help from the Black Rock Rangers. Located at the corner of 9:00 and C.

places.name: Recycle Camp
places.desc: CRUSH IT w/the Recyclenauts at Recycle Camp. Find us at our new location, 5:35 and just off the Esplanade. Bring us your mesh bags full of empty aluminum cans & ride the amazing bicycle powered Crushing Machine - The Crushinator! (plz no tin/steel/glass/plastic/trash)

places.name: Temple Guardians
places.desc: Location of the Temple Guardian & Burn Perimeter training area, as well as the Temple Guardian Helpdesk. Camping for a few guardians and guardian leadership cadre.

places.name: the black hole
places.desc: The Black Hole is a Staff Camp supporting the needs of Gate, Perimeter and Exodus.

places.name: Waterworks
places.desc: A part of Burning Man's Department of Public Works, the Waterworks team manages the Civic Water Program. This includes the delivery logistics of large water deliveries on playa to infrastructure, honorarium art, and theme camps with interactive water usage.  Our office can be found on Esplanade at 5:20 between HEaT and Moop Map HQ.

places.name: Yellow Bike Project
places.desc: Home of the Yellow Bike Project. Please bring all Yellow Bikes in need of repair here. We will be fixing them for release back into the city. Remember not to hoard, decorate/alter, or take home Yellow Bikes . Yellow Bikes are not to be inside any camp at any time. SHARE them.

places.name: Pink Mammoth
places.desc: We create an inclusive environment of love, compassion, connection, and self expression through dance, both on and off the playa.

places.name: Breakaway Republic
places.desc: Tiny Arms Tavern welcomes all dinosaurs for libations and roar-ing laughter. Open every day, look for the giant T-Rex. Espresso martinis and wine from 9-12 every day!

places.name: Dusty Bunnies
places.desc: Camp Dusty Bunnies - get a new outfit at the Boutique, taste strange foods at Bunny's Deli, dance and mingle with your new best friends in our Lounge. Plus, watch for Bunny's Pop-up Bistro to randomly appear on the Playa.

places.name: This Is It
places.desc: This is a camp serving hot & iced tea with offerings of a phone charging station and ASL conversation.

places.name: Camp of the Rising Buns
places.desc: Camp of the Rising Buns is a community that celebrates the many gifts of the sun. Come to our Abuntent to experience the renewal of a new day while basking in the evaporative cooling powered by the gift of the sun's rays. Stop by at sunset daily for Bunset Karaoke + Rising Buns Bakery & Cool Your Buns Snowcones. "Sun's out, Buns out!"

places.name: The Market
places.desc: Imagine you are wandering through Playa on your way home from a night of adventure or just starting out in search of adventure. Your stomach growls a bit, maybe you feel just a tiny bit thirsty. From afar you see a gathering of carts, lit up and welcoming. What's going on over there? You pedal towards it and stumble upon The Market. You are suddenly surrounded with stands offering their goods. You

places.name: Sidequest Sideshow
places.desc: Clownin' around!

places.name: PLUR Pups
places.desc: Human Pup Play (no bio-pups involved!) is a role playing activity that brings play, immediacy, and unconditional affection back to adult life. It came from queer kink culture, but any adult can join! Get on all fours, bark at your friends, play fetch, wag your tail, or just take a nap in a blissful dogpile. The PLUR Pups doghouse is your headquarters for pup culture on the playa. Drop by to learn

places.name: Deoxidized
places.desc: We are a global community of artists, builders, entrepreneurs, and explorers who come together to create a welcoming neighborhood on the playa. Our theme, the Global Neighborhood Oasis, reflects our belief that connection and participation are at the heart of Black Rock City. By day, we host our Soul Series in our shaded Oasis with guided talks, workshops, and reflective experiences. By night, our

places.name: Hungry Games
places.desc: Step right up and spin our interactive game wheel for a chance to win a hot slice of fresh pizza. You might face off in a quick round of rock paper scissors or score an automatic win to satisfy your hunger. Our entire crew works together to hype up the crowd and keep the ovens firing for these spontaneous street parties. When the games take a break we invite you to sit down and relax at our schedu

places.name: Our Own Devices
places.desc: Home base for Our Own Devices, a massive metal pop-up book unfolding from the playa. Swing by to talk about tall tales, engineering puzzles, and the fine art of using serious skills for deeply unserious things.

places.name: Church of Chill
places.desc: Come be Chill and enjoy a drink at our misted and shaded chapel. Leave a confession for others to read. Divinity and anhidrosis for all!

places.name: House of Sammich
places.desc: We serve gourmet, gluten-free, cinnamon-buttered toasted, peanut-butter and jelly sammiches. All that we ask is for you to provide us with a taste of YOUR flavor. Sing us a song..., tell us a joke..., confess a sin.., the dirtier the better. We also provide a moving cuddle puddle which is all about conscious conversations: opening up, connecting, and sharing what's going on inside oneself.

places.name: Your New Friend
places.desc: Supporting the "Your New Friend" deep playa art piece, we also welcome you to drop in and say hello to the idiots gathered here at camp. We would love to hear your Burning Man story, and promise to only make a tiny amount of fun of you.

places.name: Joey Glowey Bar
places.desc: Work Access Camp

places.name: Fat Panda
places.desc: Art support for Jeremiah, Sunrise Sentinals, and Refrenda

places.name: Iron Monkeys
places.desc: Home to the Iron Monkeys

places.name: Solid City
places.desc:
We're mothers, daughters, siblings, and partners and maybe a cuz or two parts of a grown-ass family camp encouraging strong bonds among Black and brown Burners and their families ~ and what better way to do that than by tossing them in an ESCAPE ROOM laced with puzzles forcing you to use critical thinking skills!? 

If you can make it through our 90's cityscape and out the other side to our street

places.name: Bat Haus
places.desc: Art support camp

places.name: Abraxas Camp
places.desc:
Abraxas Dragon has been on playa since 2006, providing incredible music, art and vibes. This year is the 20th Anniversary of Abraxas!

Abraxas has a history of being one of the most recognizable and photogenic art cars on the playa. We believe that art car magic can be created with dedication, commitment and basic tools and supplies. We live this dream and aspire to show burners that they can too.

places.name: Empire of Dirt
places.desc:
At Empire of Dirt, we don't just build mutant vehicles...we launch dreams into orbit. Our camp is a hub of performance, creativity, collaboration, and full-on playa absurdity. We're proud to be a returning Burning Man camp based in Oakland, California, with a long tradition of mobile art, DIY ethics, and radical participation.

Interactivity is Our Mission

places.name: High Maintenance Entertainment
places.desc: Somewhere between cocktail hour and the open Playa, you'll find us - a loose constellation of builders, wanderers, and night owls hailing from the SF Bay Area, Colorado, and Australia. We gave life to Noetica in 2017 and Spark: A Burning Man Story in 2014. Now we keep the Bioluminescent Slug glowing, the drinks flowing, and our doors open to anyone who wants a ride under the stars. High Maintenanc

places.name: Colita de Rana
places.desc: We are the friends and creators of the mesmerizing frog who glides around the playa in his dapper top hat. Become hypnotized by his glowing aura and find yourself transported to a new destination.

places.name: PlayaDough
places.desc: Are you a burner hungry in body and in spirit? PlayaDough will treat you to delicious dumplings, vodka and unsafe doses of eastern european nihilism.

places.name: ArtSled
places.desc: Step into a glowing spherical space where creativity and community come alive. Sip tea from a samovar, grab a pencil or marker, and join in collaborative drawing or live karaoke. DJ sets and music fill the air, inviting everyone to dance, relax, or simply enjoy the shared energy. Our camp is open to all, encouraging participation, playful exploration, and connection. Whether you're here to create,

places.name: Yaass Daddy!
places.desc: Art support camp for Canis Minor

places.name: Snarky Marquee
places.desc: Have something to say, stop by the Snarky Marquee and say it. Our snark masters will help you get the word out.

places.name: La Calaca Village
places.desc: La Calaca Village offers a theme camp, art car and artist support on playa. We pride ourselves on being makers, teachers and healers . Come for the healing, stay for the hedonism! Spiritual healers, yogis and massage artists await you in our Healing Plaza. Wanna help build and work on a big art car? Visit the "Imagination Station Piazza" featuring different activities and gatherings daily!

places.name: Camp (Can't) Stop
places.desc: Camp (Can't) STOP - purveyors of joy and peddlers of silly. What are we up to? You'll just have to STOP by and find out. We'd never STOP a good time - but we might STOP your journey for something way better than whatever it was you were planning on doing. We can't STOP won't STOP and are committed to the bit - whatever that bit might be.

places.name: Counter Culture
places.desc: We are the BRC Census support camp. Drop by anytime to learn about what Census does and the information we have to share.

places.name: Choo Choo
places.desc: We have two art cars, bipolar express trains, we drive around the playa and play music, this year we will still build art.

places.name: Frizz
places.desc: A chill cafe & bar to come retire at!

places.name: Happy Seats
places.desc: Decorate your bike! - seat cushions upgrades, handle bar tassels, DIY license plates, and fun time with new friends under a cool canopy

places.name: Camp Fly
places.desc: Camp Fly is the home of our insect themed art cars. Swing by our camp to get a ride, or reach out if you would like us to help host your event. At our camp, we have a pickleball court and an aerial silks rig, on which we will be offering aerial silks performances and lessons, please come find us!

places.name: Mouse Trap
places.desc: Keep your friends close, but your cheese closer!

places.name: THICC VIBEZ
places.desc: We will have a branch from the giving tree art car that we have not used on the at car for sometime now. We will be mounting this 8' long horizontally arched branch 15' high off one of our frontage street corners, with 12' long GREEN vines hanging from the branch blowing in the wind like a flag. It looks just like the art car so people will know what camp we are when the art car is away from camp.

places.name: Star Buds
places.desc: This is the dedicated heart and support for the Sanctuary of the Silent Star.. Come share a cup of tea in our cozy lounge and discover quiet clues on how to unlock the mysteries of the .... We invite you to trade the noise of the city for a moment of meaningful stillness and communal connection. Our space is a soft landing for weary travelers.

places.name: Struggletown Station
places.desc: Struggletown Station is the depot station for The Struggle Bus artcar. Come hitch a ride with us for art tours and just exploring the amazing Playa sites and sounds.

places.name: Disco Mushroom
places.desc:
We are Disco Mushroom's humans. 
We love disco anything & everything! 
Come say hello!

Love,
Alpine Artists Collective

places.name: Pranksters in the Pines
places.hometown: South Lake Tahoe / Reno / Las Vegas
places.desc: Brought to you by the Merry Pranksters... A nice blend of art, life, and Laughter. Dont be a Dullard, come have some laughs.

places.name: LIZARD
places.desc: Our camp welcomes you to enjoy Oriental food at any time, and we also provide iced water and drinks.

places.name: Arctic Court
places.desc: Multi national art support camp of Arctic Court 360

places.name: Chair Camp
places.desc: The Dusty, cozy-as-can-be living room with room for all of our Chair, automan, and TV people. Chair Camp is proud to be on playa for the fourth year, with 6 mutant vehicles and a 24/7 lounge-pad for when we're done stomping around deep playa + giving lifts to our burner neighbors and off adventuring. Cold beverages and warm, cozy hangs— Purrr.

places.name: FDA: Food & Dance Administration
places.desc: If you're on the hunt for a warm bite to eat, a drink, and a chill spot to groove to some kick-ass beats, your quest ends here! Report to the food & Dance Administration and make new friends at our daily themed Beats and Eats events. Back for a 4th year of valuing self-expression, openness, and an infectious vibe of fun, we guarantee genuine connections, thought-provoking ideas, and unique themed

places.name: Dome Sweet Dome
places.desc: A group of long time burners happy to be in Black Rock City. Come by and visit and check out our Mutant Vehicles.

places.name: Charting the Uncharted
places.desc: Charting the Uncharted is an Oklahoma-based camp of first-time Burners supporting our interactive art installation, The Witness Wall. We invite participants to share their stories through writing and audio, creating a living map of human medial experience. Rooted in curiosity, connection, and contribution, our camp is dedicated to exploration - of both the desert and the voices within it.

places.name: Black Rock Labs The Expanse
places.desc: Black Rock Labs is a Civic Support camp focused on testing/scaling/messaging climate smart regenerative technologies at Black Rock City and the Regionals. Black Rock Labs hosts 1-hour Sustainability Talk Series at 2 pm on Tuesday/Wednesday/Friday and a Playa-wide tour on the Abraxas art car at 4 pm on Thursday to view BRC's expanding deployment of renewables and regenerative climate smart activiti

places.name: Extinct Oasis
places.desc: Trust your senses, this is not a mirage! Extinct Oasis is a shaded, mist-cooled, prehistoric-themed space mixing up refreshing drinks and tasty beats. Get a break from the sun, hydrate with a tasty cocktail/mocktail, dance to music (with words), or just lounge on our comfy oversized blowup furniture.

places.name: pandemonium
places.desc:
kinky or jus curious ? either way we have a home for you at camp pandemonium. Where chaos becomes joy, and pain is pleasure.
Home of the Flaming Heart. come enjoy some of our guided kink classes in rope, flogging /impact, and fireplay. enjoy our 2 story pyramid and grand views above the dust . swing is our lyra open 24/7. dance w djs on our intimate dance floor. meet old friends and make new ones.

places.name: Lightning Bug Lounge
places.desc: A family-friendly camp supporting Spark the Firefly as she flickers across the playa, glowing with the warmth and nostalgia of evenings spent chasing lightning bugs.

places.name: Love Tripping
places.desc: Trip & stumble out of your den and into our arms. We're here to show you love all week, with events of affection, appreciation, curiosity, and acceptance. Featuring the Touchless Love Wash, 18-Hand Massage, Naked Breakfast Slop, the ASMR Salon, and the gargantuan Book of Understanding.

places.name: Acid On Ice
places.desc: Step into a snowstorm of silliness at Acid on Ice! We're a frosty oasis serving chilled vibes, mulled wines, and warm welcomes. Join us at our snow-themed lounge and bar for mist-cooled hangouts, icy karaoke, and popsicle mischief. Whether you're escaping the heat or diving into connection, our camp is your winter wonderland in the dust.

places.name: Playacuda
places.desc: Home base for Playacuda, a mutant vehicle roaming the playa in search of connection and good energy. We offer a laid-back spot to pause, cool down, and meet fellow travelers. No schedule, no pressure, just spontaneous moments and open invitations. Swing by and you might end up on your next adventure.

places.name: Metamorphosis Energy Lab
places.desc: An electric-powered mutant vehicle support camp dedicated to the art and science of energy transformation on the playa. Our fully solar-powered base of operations keeps our all electric mutant Vehicle (The Hungry Caterpillar) running day and night, ferrying participants across Black Rock City with zero emissions. We believe in the metamorphic power of radical technology, clean energy, and communit

places.name: Lookout! The Camp
places.desc: Absurdity disguised as a fire extinguisher. The art support camp for "Lookout!"

places.name: BlinkingManCamp97
places.desc: BlinkingManCamp97 blinks again where excess just never seems to be enough. We will have the usual art project on the trash fence - SK8Z, 50 skateboard decks decorated with past Bman themes. When in camp prove how smart you are by passing the wacky IQ Test and becoming a MENSA member, normal answers wont get you there! And of course we have a Dragnet Interrogation, our tradition since 1999. Remembe

places.name: Luminary Camp
places.desc: Support camp for Luminary and The Love Beacon MVs

places.name: Eitherlight
places.desc: A place to dream and connect with light lovers and sonic connoisseurs.

places.name: Mona Camp
places.desc:
Welcome to Mona Camp, where the spirit of caring, loving, and creativity thrives amidst the vast expanse of the playa. As part of the same community that brought you the Huge Mona Bunny in 2023, the enchanting Mona Mushroom in 2024, and the MONA DIE! DIE! DIE! burn in 2025. We are dedicated to spreading the Mona spirit far and wide.

We believe in the power of art to inspire, connect, and uplift s

places.name: Helios Hideout
places.desc: Helios is a symbol of rebirth after hard times. It is a celebration of humanity and an invitation for us all to stand together in the challenging times ahead.

places.name: Gritty Garden
places.desc: Gritty Garden is a diversity driven camp offering a wide variety of workshops. Monday Craft Maker's Day, Heart-to-Heart hug workshop, the Joy of Cunnilingus, and How to Give Good NO. Sunday - Saturday refreshments Bar and ice cream.

places.name: Tree of Love
places.desc: Step into a legendary oasis where ancient strength meets modern rhythm. Our camp welcomes all weary travelers to find shade under our monumental tree and dance in the shadow of heroic man and woman warrior statues. Whether you're looking to catch a high-energy sunset DJ set, admire the prototypes of our open-playa art, or simply cool down with a refreshing drink, we offer a cornerstone of communit

places.name: BUBBLEGASM
places.desc: Bubblegasm is a mutant vehicle built to spread the joy of bubbles and lights with all those who ride on her or dance and play around her. Bubbles are a metaphor for life, fleeting and fragile and are a reminder about how precious our time is while we are here, and to make the most of each moment. And like each bubble, each person and their life is beautiful and unique. Bubbles are also temporary a

places.name: STRANGELOVE
places.desc:
Fly the Friendly! 

Come get your altitude and your attitude adjusted in our airliner-themed lounge, where each afternoon you can enjoy the company of your fellow jet-setters while you sip ice-cold draft beer or a signature cocktail and groove to tasty house beats at our 16-foot wing-shaped bar.

places.name: Mindseye Bonsai
places.desc: We are a small art support camp of builders, artists, scientists, and dusty travelers from all over the world. Our mission is to bring sculpture to the playa and have a good time doing it. With 10 years of experience bringing art to Burning Man, we love sharing neuroscience-inspired art and curiosity with fellow dusty desert folks. If that sounds like your kind of camp, reach out and come join us.

places.name: Tengri Camp
places.desc: A glowing yurt encampment where the wind carries stories, music, and the memory of the steppe. Within warm circular shelters, strangers become guests, guests become family, sharing tea, song, and slow moments of presence under the desert sky. On Wednesday and Friday from 3 to 5 pm, we gift communal meals as gatherings of hospitality and shared tradition. By day and night, we offer a space to rest,

places.name: Touch Glass
places.desc: Art support camp creating the 2026 Honoraria piece Kaleidoscope.

places.name: Renewables For Artists RAT HQ
places.desc: Provides information and resources to artists and camps to support on-playa solar renewable power installations. Ditch the generator, rely on the sun! It is easy, and we are here to help. Visit us on playa to learn more about playa solar solutions, from tiny projects to the Temple. Enjoy a refreshing freezy pop or cup of tea while you rest in our shady lounge. Read up on best practices and solar s

places.name: Camp Condundrum
places.desc: Playa got you in a difficult place? Camp Conundrum might just be the answer. Our mutant vehicle, a delightful conundrum in itself, offers hydration, music to move you, and a pole for the ... adventurous.

places.name: Water Suckers
places.desc: A welcoming bar and lounge camp with music, dancing, and a shaded space to gather on the playa. Our core interactivity is an open portrait and live sketch experience for the Black Rock City community, where passersby can sit for a quick portrait, share a story, strike a pose, or co-create a moment through drawing. Add a small story, poem, gesture, prompt, or playful offering to the exchange.

places.name: Sound Cabin
places.desc: Welcomed to everyone to join us for rides around the playa. Just find us and jump on.

places.name: Central Cafe
places.desc:
Central Cafe is a 24/7 open coffee lounge in the heart of Black Rock City. A warm, welcoming space where you can slow down, reconnect, and meet new people at any time of day or night.

Come for high quality coffee, fresh beverages, and a cozy style lounge filled with sofas, rugs, and glowing amber light. By day it is a vibrant social cafe, by night it transforms into an intimate coffee lounge with

places.name: Enrichment.Institute
places.desc:
The Aperture Science Enrichment Center ("Portal") has joined forces with The Institute ("Fallout") to form the Enrichment.Institute

The Enrichment.Institute reminds you that the Weighted Companion Cube will never threaten to stab you and, in fact, cannot speak. However, any advice it does give you should be radically included.

The Weighted Companion Cubes are from the computer game "Portal"; thi

places.name: Dustmight
places.desc:
Art support camp for Voxelite, a volumetric light sculpture.

Previous projects have included Popstar, the mobile popcorn stand!

places.name: Dinosaur King
places.desc: Welcome to Dinosaur King, where prehistoric power meets the playa. Our camp is anchored by the Dinosaur King art car -- a full-body dinosaur skeleton mutant vehicle approximately 30 feet long and 12 feet tall, fabricated from steel and covered in thousands of programmable LEDs. A live DJ booth is built directly inside the skeleton's body cavity, where performers spin sets from within the belly of

places.name: San Marco Square
places.desc: A camp of creators and community, named after Venice's most famous public square, this is the kind of place you stumble into and then forget to leave. Come up to the Sky Bar, a fully built out cocktail lounge that hydraulically rises 15 to 20 feet above the playa, for a gifted drink and a view of Black Rock City that does not exist anywhere else. On the ground, a sprawling shaded plaza hosts daily

places.name: MAXA
places.desc: We are Maxa, rooted in family. built by hand We create warmth, bringing people together through art and music.

places.name: Elsewhere Institute
places.desc: Interactive science museum that finally explains why we remember experiencing history differently, known as the 'Mandela effect'

places.name: Camp Kühloff
places.desc: This year we are coming to you! Camp Kuhloff Pop-up events are happening Monday-Thursday 2pm-4pm throughout the playa where we will be passing out ice-cold lavender towels and good vibes. Be on the look out for our inflatable yeti!

places.name: OHM HOME
places.desc: We are a mutant vehicle support camp. Home of Ohm Kar, Manta and Vibe Apple. Come n boogie. Take the ride.

places.name: Playa Peace Project
places.desc: Playa Peace Project is a global movement of artists, dreamers, and doers — united by music, generosity, and the spirit of adventure. We're a theme camp and international sound collective that brings music, art, and magic to the playa and beyond. We support emerging artists and bring them to Burning Man for the first time. We are San Francisco based.

places.name: Camp Connection
places.desc: Art support camp that loves to share their love of creating art

places.name: Coming Home
places.desc: Art Installation "Coming Home"

places.name: BRCSPCA (anti-human society)
places.desc: We are a small, welcoming camp focused on connection, creativity, and community care. Our central dome hosts daily interactive offerings like conversation games, pop-up workshops, and cozy lounges where anyone can drop in to chill, connect, or collaborate. Whether you're looking for a deep talk, a silly prompt, or a moment of rest, we offer a space that's low-key, low-barrier, and open to all. Com

places.name: Draft Punk
places.desc:
In the future, Daft Punk steals OUR name, "dRaft Punk".
We're here to steal it back.
And we brought a LOT of ice-cold beer with us.
Grab a cold one on the go, or hang out with us for the day.

places.name: As Above So At Camp
places.desc: We are the support camp for the Honoraria artwork As Above, So Within, a sculptural installation inspired by Persian mythology, mathematics, and fractal geometry. Our crew brings together artists, builders, designers, and fabricators supporting the piece from build through strike. The work explores the ancient idea that the patterns above us are reflected within us, using form, light, and computat

places.name: Navigate to YES
places.desc: Find your destiny on playa with our GPS - Global Persuasion System

places.name: Seashell Cartel
places.desc: A tiny nautical syndicate in support of the PlayaBoot, a mutant vehicle shaped like a boot with a pineapple on top.  Come for the Boot, stay for the questionable maritime affiliations.

places.name: Ragnarokk
places.desc: Ragnarokk is the End and the Beginning. It tells a story where destruction is necessary for creation to flourish. It is rebirth, it is recovery, it is rejuvenation, it is a renaissance, it is renewal, restoration, and resurrection. It is what we are experiencing in our lives right now. It is Burning Man. And now, it is us. We are camp Ragnarokk!

places.name: Moonraker
places.desc: Moonraker Mutant vehicle, 10th year.

places.name: The Makers Space
places.desc: We are an art support camp and would love to offer support to the artists and builders on playa. with help, food, drinks, materials, other resources if needed.

places.name: KonaZona Coffee & Tiki Bar
places.desc: KonaZona  Tiki Bar, Serving Liquid Hugs for your brain in a Tropical  setting.  Coffee in the morning, Mai Tai's in the Afternoon.  Chill in our Tropical Hammocks  and relax with the soothing Hawaii sounds and cooling surroundings

places.name: Airpusher Collective
places.desc: The Airpusher camp is the port from which our fantastical airship begins and ends her voyages.  Join us for music and joy.  Check our event schedule and meet us at camp prior to our published airship rides to playa and beyond.

places.name: Kaya
places.desc: Home of the Fire Breathing Dragon Art Car, Gon KiRin. Stop by our camp to enjoy music, meet our camp members from around the globe and experience an authentic tea ceremony by tea masters from China. We are a diverse group of burners brought together by our love for art, music and cultural exchange. Feel free to ask questions about our mutant vehicle and maybe catch a ride with us out to playa!

places.name: White Elephant Exchange
places.desc: The White Elephant Exchange is a waypoint for roving pachyderms from all eras, generations, and originations to gather. We are brought together by our love of our substantial Funkadelephant and joy of celebrations and adventures. Come by to find the Funkadelephant and its growing family, or come find us roaming the wide open Playa.

places.name: The Back Hole
places.desc: GPE Staff and Volunteer Camping: Where Gate goes to Sleep or recover

places.name: Terrapin Station
places.desc: The Galactic Terrapin lives to take you on intergalactic adventures of epic proportions. You're always "home" when you're with us, so swing by, take a trip and find your own Axis Mundi.

places.name: Hooter Tooterville
places.desc: Hooter Tooterville is a small art support camp dedicated to bringing fun and original art to the Playa.  This year's art installation is called "Teeny Weeny Hooter Tooter", a fun set of 4 teeters powering two walls of musical pipes and fun things to look at.

places.name: The G Spot
places.desc: The G Spot is hard to find. A surreal junkyard where anything goes, and nothing is what it seems. Rare pokemon are born here. Come for the mystery, stay for the mayhem.

places.name: 42 Ramen
places.desc: We know the answer to the ultimate question. If you know it, come and tell us to claim your yummy prize.

places.name: For the Glory of The C Ship
Camp Fortress of Solitude
places.desc: Superman's Fortress of Solitude Art Car support camp.

places.name: sunny side up
places.desc: Art camp for burning man art installation "sunny side up"

places.name: Sha La La
places.desc: We are SHALALA, a fun inclusive camp with little pop up events daily including wellness and Bloody Mary mornings. Espresso martini lounge evenings and specialty cocktail happy hours.

places.name: Wild Tribe
places.desc: Wild Tribe is a camp of professional circus artists and fire dancers.

places.name: AmberDust
places.desc: A retro-futuristic lounge camp built around the AmberDust Express art installation, blending interactive lights, music, shade, and spontaneous social chaos. Wander in for glowing nighttime vibes, unexpected conversations, late-night dancing, and our legendary returning sausage parties. By day, relax in our shaded gathering space; by night, watch the camp transform into an illuminated social playgr

places.name: Holy Babel
places.desc: The Art of Such n Such is returning to BRC. This time, we are an art support camp, led by Charlie Blackcat Smith who will be working on a collaborative. fire based art piece that will serve as a memorial for Brian Doherty who met a fast fate in March. Brian literally wrote the book on Burning Man titled "This is Burning Man" in 2004. This will be a small camp centered on erecting and managing the

places.name: The Mystical Grill
places.desc: A global circle of kindred spirits united by fire, flavor, and story. We gift two styles of traditional Argentinian Asado from our open grill and invite Burners to gather for communal meals, spontaneous storytelling, readings from our camp tarot reader, and soul warming connection. We honor food as a ritual, fire as transformation, and the Playa as our shared home.

places.name: Harmonic Drift
places.desc:
Everything is an instrument. Everyone is a musician.

Harmonic Drift is a mobile sound installation and open jam experience built on one belief: music belongs to everyone. Our hand-pulled trailer carries 35 gongs, found object percussion, and things that don't have names yet. Wherever it lands, it becomes a stage for whoever shows up.

When we're not on the playa or at Center Camp, we're parked ou

places.name: Camp ASL Support Services HUB
places.desc: American sign language Support services. Centralized services for the Deaf. Spanish speaking services provided as well. Come and flip a table. Come hang out by the fire pit after dark whenever it happens

places.name: D.F.C.B.(Don't Fckn' Care Bear)
places.desc: Welcome to "(Don't)_Care_A_Lot" the official home for the Don't Fckn' Care Bear art car. Please be quiet around here because the little bears are sleeping...

places.name: Davey Jones Locker Pirate Cove
places.desc: The Davey Jones Locker is docked in pirates cove this year!  Come climb aboard the top of the ship via the fishy climbing net off the side!  Sing some sea shanties with us, relax in the shade on the roof deck or enjoy some weird wacky and wonderful music, which half comes from boxes of records!  Come come pick some music and play!

places.name: Resonance
places.desc: An art support camp for the Resonance Tree  which is a large-scale immersive art installation made entirely of bamboo, designed and built by Resonance Studio. It responds to sun, shadow, sound, and movement. Rising seven meters above the playa, the Tree invites people to enter through woven roots, climb through the trunk, rest in canopy nets, and gather beneath a living canopy of shadow and sound.

places.name: Icarus Camp
places.desc:
Icarus Camp
A collection of humans from across the globe, who were brought together show all, LOVE.

places.name: Tequila Bees
places.desc: The Tequila Bees are a Hive Like No Other, come see what the Buzz is about

places.name: Booboos Gaagoos
places.desc: Step right up to the Inaugural Officially Certified Peer-Reviewed Burning Man Awards, the most rigorous celebration of playa excellence in the known universe. Our panel of wildly unqualified judges reviews your finest achievements, from heroic dust storm survival to best abandoned bike rescue, and awards genuine medals of entirely dubious authority. Pull up a seat, plead your case, and claim the r

places.name: MIDAS TEAR COLLECTIVE
places.desc: Step into a welcoming French gathering space where conversations flow alongside French wine and cheese. Join us in building a collaborative geometric sculpture using Zometool, an evolving creation shaped collectively throughout the week. At sunrise, gather beneath The Tear of Midas for meditation, reflection, and community sharing circles. Relax, create, exchange ideas, and imagine new ways of liv

places.name: Playa Pete's Plaza
places.desc: We built a ship that doesn't float to sail on a lake that isn't there.

places.name: Hushville
places.desc: A welcoming camp with no amplified music or generators. First time burners greeted with joy and mentored with care. We welcome campers from across the world and beyond. We've had people from every continent camp with us in the past. Many activities all week long.

places.name: Electric Dandelion
places.desc: The Electric Dandelion is a 24 ft. tall dandelion sculpture that doubles as fireworks at night. The dandelion bulb comes to life at night as the LED animations take hold and mesmerize you with their bright and intense light show. Sit down and enjoy the lights or dance and see the beautiful geometrically designed metal and acrylic sculpture.

places.name: Words Left Unsaid
places.desc: The project is an antique table and chairs with an antique phone made up in the past, with a Frame that welcomes you to words left unsaid, calls to the other side.

places.name: Dream. Fold. Fly
places.desc:
An enlarged paper airplane and paper boat made out of wood stand as symbols of courage and trust.

The airplane represents our deepest dreams — the ones we often keep hidden inside our hearts. It reminds us that dreams are not meant to stay folded. They are meant to be released into open space and given the chance to rise.
The paper boat represents faith and surrender the willingness to let life c

places.name: Nova
places.desc: Nova is a stellated dodecahedron slowly spinning on a wood platform. It was named after the exploding star. As the star throws off its matter, this art piece represents ideas generated during the creative process. Some will be lost to the ether but others coalesce into reality.

places.name: Serendipity Machine
places.hometown: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, United States
places.desc: The Serendipity Machine stands as a whimsical, steampunk-inspired installation, evoking the charm of an old-fashioned invention designed to transform the unexpected into positive outcomes. The structure stands as a gentle provocation for human connection, offering a moment of pause amid the chaos of the playa. Each interaction is designed to evoke reflection, emotional honesty, and spontaneous enc

places.name: Center of the Universe
places.desc: The Center of the Universe is a 36" diameter metal art piece that looks like a manhole cover. It is designed for participants to stand on the art and take a picture of their feet and the art piece. There is a 26 foot arrow set at an angle and pointing to the Center of the Universe.  During the day the arrow can be seen from a distance as it is painted green. At night the arrow is lit with green pl

places.name: The Divine Hand
places.desc: The Divine Hand hovers above the playa, suspended between sky and dust. It is for seekers who understand they may not receive what they want, but instead what they need. Some pass without noticing. Others pause and feel something shift, through a quiet, personal gift.

places.name: Axis of Stillness
places.desc: Axis of Stillness is an 8-foot pyramid of hand-laid mosaic tile mounted on an engineered EMT conduit frame. Four identical triangular panels — each assembled from mirrored, colored tiles — reflect sunlight in shifting patterns by day and glow with concealed LED lighting by night. The piece references ancient sacred geometry to create a contemplative focal point: a quiet center amid the motion of B

places.name: Hug Cabana
places.desc: Hugging booth for interactive hug experiences.

places.name: SK8Z
places.desc: SK8Z!  Once again Dragnet brings a group of artists' work to the deepest playa...40 skateboard decks will be placed on 40 T-stakes on the trash fence, each uniquely decorated and representing one of the themes and years of the 40th anniversary of Burning Man. Recycled, thrift stores, garage sales, found objects are used for  the subject matter...you may remember the tennis rackets, tikis or fish,

places.name: Plastic Planet
places.desc:
A sphere which denotes the planet, with blue soda bottles for the oceans, and green for the continents. There are 5 red soda bottles which represent the planet's five garb patches, or gyres. 

Originally brought to playa in 2014 and again in 2025.

places.name: Unity Locus Focuser
places.desc: The Unity Locus Focuser pulls in the universe's energies and focuses them into its spherical Third Eye. Participants walk along either of its catwalks to its Third Eye, then immerse their heads within it, experiencing the energy and views from within it together. Unity within the Third Eye is manifested through sounds, lighting, warmth, inspiring views, and the other participant's close proximity.

places.name: No Race
places.desc: No Race is an inverted three-tier podium constructed from reclaimed wooden pallets, installed directly on the open playa. The familiar structure of first-, second-, and third-place is flipped upside down, collapsing its hierarchy. The widest platform rests above a compressed base, creating a visually destabilized form. "NO RACE" appears in bold, hand-painted lettering across the front. The piece t

places.name: Thoughts by the Edge
places.hometown: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, United States
places.desc: A small collection of meanderings perched on a tree at the edge of the playa.

places.name: Unhinged Lingering
places.desc: A freestanding architectural fragment: a standard exterior house door centered within two flat reclaimed-wood walls. The structure faces deep playa on one side and Black Rock City on the other, positioning the doorway between origin and possibility. The door opens to open playa, revealing not a house or destination but the horizon.  It explores limbo as a physical space — neither entry nor exit, b

places.name: Party in a Box
places.desc: Party in a Box is a large-scale interactive structure where participants can choose their own [party] adventure. There are designated areas of the structure for participants to add onto or otherwise modify the piece, making it a constantly evolving work in progress. Just like you.

places.name: Temple of the Moon
places.artist: Moonlight Collective and the Temple Build Crew, Lead Artist James Gwertzman
places.desc: The Temple of the Moon is inspired by the Queen of the Night flower, a fragrant desert cactus blossom (Epiphyllum oxypetalum) which blooms only once each year, at night, and whose flowers wilt before dawn. In this act of ephemeral beauty, we find a profound metaphor for our own brief beautiful lives on this planet, as well as for Burning Man itself, which blossoms each year in the dust of the play

places.name: Hortus Lux
places.desc: Inspired by succulents in the arid desert, Hortus Lux is a restful oasis by day and an invitation to play by night. Each of the five woven hammock leaves accommodates two. Seated burners listen to guided meditations synced to light and haptic vibrations.

places.name: Unpopular Music (or UNPOP)
places.artist: Evidence, Stephan Moore and Scott Smallwood
places.desc: UNPOP, or Unpopular Music, is an intimate listening environment in deepest playa. It features exquisite, detailed sound-works, including field recordings, abstract electroacoustic music, ambient textures, and other (mostly) non-beat-oriented sonic experiences, composed by many artists from around the world. Encompassing a circular space, the piece is built around eight custom-built Hemisphere loud

places.name: face2face
places.desc: face2face is as simple as could be. A chair for "you" and a chair for "your new friend". You sit and who will appear to sit with you? Will the conversation flow? Will it be exciting, awkward-or maybe even playa magical? You'll never know unless you sit.

places.name: A Svengali Gala
places.desc: In a last-ditch effort to boost her popularity, Emma, the Emerald Wasp, invited her fellow freeloaders, sycophants and leeches to a week-long extravaganza at her long-abandoned childhood home. Meanwhile Norma and Shambooshka stop by to see what all the fuss is about.

places.name: Mother II: More love inside
places.desc: This sculpture captures the eternal bond between mother and child, celebrating the strength, tenderness, and unwavering support of motherhood. It stands as a monument to the foundational role of care in our society. Everything begins inside.

places.name: Moth
places.desc: This statue captures the tension between Western trinity and Eastern duality. Three arms represent facets of human striving: will (weapon), understanding (knowledge), and exploration (lantern). These are expressions of the self shaping reality through action, thought, and intuition. Yet the two legs ground the figure in duality — yin and yang, light and shadow, life and death. The insect-like form

places.name: Pull Slowly and See
places.desc: What is it? What's in this? You'll only find out if you pull slowly and see!

places.name: BYTE: Chip and Terra
places.desc:
Chip and Terra are big cuddle bugs with bulbous mirrored eyeballs that emit dancing beams of light at night. 

Chip's underbelly gives life to a hanging wisteria garden where adventurous humans may find hidden gifts hanging among the flowered vines or wedged in the graffitied rafters, alongside beautiful messages of appreciation and art from past BRC citizens. You may even find a serene chill spac

places.name: Nature Goddess
places.desc: The purpose of this work is to showcase the beauty of coexistence between humans and nature, presenting the most authentic human form in the form of nudity, and conveying the most primitive beauty on this planet.

places.name: Enlightenment
places.desc:
Direct from the blessed soil of Elysara comes a single, displaced specimen of the Caudex mnemosyne. Unlike the "killer plants" of sci-fi tropes or the death-worlds Burners are familiar with, this Pachycaul-like organism is not a predator—it is a scavenger.

Enlightenment is a biological curiosity that harvests the one thing humans possess in toxic excess: unwanted memories. It survives by metabo

places.name: Cardinal Gates
places.desc:
Cardinal Gates explores the passage of time and how life is made up of fleeting, ever-changing moments. Our piece honors the cardinal directions and the sundials before them that have guided explorers for thousands of years. We are all explorers finding our way. 

The gates are a pop of saturated color in the playa landscape. Up close, during the day, they create a moving story of shadows captur

places.name: wild free spirit
places.desc: The Wild Free Art display is once again on the playa and will showcase original artworks. Created to share my vision of spreading love, kindness, and acceptance to everyone. Come and see what speaks to your soul and meet the artist. The universe is calling, come and see what it has to say to you through the art.

places.name: Wisdom Oasis
places.desc: The philosophy of The Stump centers on the balance between nature and human creation. How life, even when altered, continues to flow through transformation. It reflects the cycle of decay and renewal: a fallen tree reborn through art, machinery, and water. The merging of living textures with gears and chains symbolizes harmony between organic and industrial worlds. The continuous sound of flowing

places.name: LAMP
places.desc: LAMP draws visitors in with mesmerizing shadow patterns dancing across triangular shade sails. Inside, a cozy nest of pillows and rugs awaits beneath a canopy of shimmering LED pebble lights. Hidden buttons scattered throughout the space trigger synchronized light and sound experiences—deep bass vibrates through the platform while color washes across the sails above. The installation rewards curio

places.name: In This Moment
places.desc:
Born from Sally Guzman's personal journey through loss in 2025, In This Moment transforms the isolation of grief into a communal act of remembrance. Inspired by the myth of the forest witch who offers to simply listen. Sally has created a physical threshold for the weary. It is a place built for the "us" and the "now"—a sanctuary where telling a story makes the lost present once more.

Sit, tell

places.name: Eye of God
places.desc:
Delving into the neuroscience of biophotons. The work is an artistic interpretation of the interactive communication of light energy between two opposite forces.

It also philosophically shows how starting from the same raw light/energy, endless variations are hidden within.

places.name: Just A Spoonful
places.desc: Just A Spoonful is not just any umbrella, it's a larger-than-life adaptation of Mary Poppins' enchanted umbrella. Both a nostalgic tribute to this classic childhood character and homage to New Orleans culture, where umbrellas are often used as celebratory accessories in second lines. Mary Poppins has just floated in from a New Orleans parade, landing in Black Rock City, abandoning her umbrella to

places.name: Tea Bag
places.desc: Giant Tea Bag

places.name: A Cosmos Within
places.hometown: Bozeman and Great Falls, MT; Big Bear, CA; Jackson, WY; Oslo, Norway
places.desc: Lucky Deep Playa explorers may find themselves at A Cosmos Within, a meditative garden. Within the garden are benches for rest, relaxation, and reflection. An enclosed space in the Cosmos offers windows, skylights, and a comfortable refuge from the sun, wind, and dust, where visitors can select an Axis Mundi Cosmic Journey based on interactive color buttons that play a selection of meditative soun

places.name: Purrmaid
places.desc:
The Purrmaid is a half cat / half mermaid interactive sculpture.
She appears to float in a magical kelp forest while she plays the ukulele to her mythical sea creature friends. She tells the story of how important her world is to our real-life climate survival through messages dotted throughout the installation.

places.name: Tree of Exhaustion
places.hometown: Black Rock City, NV, United States
places.desc:
A curious piece resembling a tree, but not quite. 

A place for the exhausted and cosmically lost to warm-up and chill-out.

places.name: Totem of Transformation, The Shifting Balance
places.artist: Alvise and the Hippo Love Art Society
places.desc: The installation presents a totemic stack of animals drawn from symbolic traditions across cultures. A tortoise supports a globe, with a deer, an owl, and butterflies rising above. Inspired by stories of the world carried on a turtle, the work reflects on humanity's relationship with the Earth. Each animal embodies a quality: the deer, gentleness, the owl, wisdom, and the butterfly, transformation

places.name: Up Nort' Art Shanty
places.hometown: Salt Lake City, UT, United States
places.desc: Up Nort Art Shanty is a weathered ice fishing shack improbably perched on the desert lakebed where ancient Lake Lahontan once stretched for miles. Raised above the dust like a relic from another shoreline, it feels like a refuge for the weary burner wandering deep playa. Inside, a simulated ice fishing scene unfolds among fishing gear, odd memorabilia, and quietly unfolding stories of native cutth

places.name: Heart of Intentions
places.artist: Cassandra Caron, James Trebesch, Ocean Fabrication
places.desc: Heart of Intentions is a place to gather, reflect, and connect. Its large wooden heart design  quietly invites pause and contemplation. Visitors are encouraged to consider a hope or intention they wish to bring into the world. That intention is written on a small charm (provided) and placed upon the heart, joining a growing constellation of shared wishes. In return, a charm left by another is chos

places.name: Fire Circle
places.artist: Nik Tenney / Sean Burrow / Lily Pickering / Tom Kay
places.desc: Fire Circle honors the birthplace of congregation. From dusk until dawn, a sacred fire will provide a haven for warmth, intimate gatherings, and restorative programming.

places.name: CORREFOC
places.desc: Correfoc is a freestanding sculptural installation approximately 26 feet tall, conceived as a stylized human silhouette inspired by Mediterranean fire rituals. Built in wood and finished in a vibrant red tone, the piece stands as a striking landmark in the desert landscape. At night, subtle lighting enhances its silhouette and amplifies the presence of surrounding fire performances. The work explo

places.name: #MUXALOVE
places.desc: #MUXALOVE stands as a monumental 25-meter (82-foot) tall Venus Flytrap, reimagining the Axis Mundi as a biological pillar of transformation. This surreal installation features a massive kinetic head with jaws that rhythmically open and close, establishing a living presence against the desert horizon. The entire structure is internally illuminated with vibrant LED systems, casting a striking silhou

places.name: Iron Butterfly of Love
places.desc:
The Iron Butterfly of Love rises from the playa as a radiant guardian of the night. With brilliant LED wings stretching across the darkness, he shines brightly so that wanderers, dreamers, and dancers can always find their way. His light is a beacon — a symbol of safety, connection, and wonder in the vast desert.
 The Iron Butterfly communicates through sound, responding to music, voices, and the

places.name: BRC Intergalactic Spaceport
places.desc: Geez, what does a spaceport look like? This one has a 20-foot tall beacon surrounded by 4 departure/arrival posts, plus at least one plastic alien with a rolly suitcase who might reanimate themselves at any time.

places.name: Project O.C.T.O.P.U.S.
places.desc: Behold Project O.C.T.O.P.U.S.! This mechanical beast is ready and waiting to come to life, all at the turn of a crank (well, 9 cranks actually.) Created by the 9x Honorarium artists at Tyler FuQua Creations (Oregon City, OR), this is by far their most interactive and complex Playa creation to date. Inspired by the amazing works of friends Duane Flatmo and Barry Crawford, Project O.C.T.O.P.U.S. wil

places.name: Beacon of Confusion
places.desc:
You are carefree riding your bicycle near the outer boundary of Burning Man. In the distance you see a beacon of light. A glow of a different color. You ride closer to inspect. 

Several glowing lights in shades of fuchsia and gold become apparent upon arrival. It stands the height of 15 hands. Not quite a full horse you think.

A button and a crank adorn the sides of the small obelisk. Messag

places.name: Honey
places.desc: Honey, is a Positivity Watchdog, spreading good energy, warmth, and joy wherever she goes. The watch on her collar is set to 11:11 because she is all about celebrating oneness, and making wishes come true. The circular motifs on her body represent our journey within the circles of life, and each piece is chosen to reflect the beauty of the world around us. The circles are designed with gemstones,

places.name: El Diabla
places.desc: On the first Monday of the event, Crimson Rose extracts a flame from the sun to light a fire in El Diabla, a special cauldron located in Center Camp. For the flame to continue burning it must be stoked, disturbed, and kept alive throughout the entire week. We encourage all those that encounter El Diabla to help keep this flame alive.

places.name: Napahe Tunade
places.desc: Napahe Tunade is Paiute for Six Fires, which line the 6:00 keyhole and compliment El Diabla, the ritual fire of Burning Man, and the fire garden and Fire Conclave Convergence.  Come and dance with the fire, perhaps roast a marshmallow or be mesmerized by the dancing flames or feel the calm from the flaming zen garden.

places.name: Ghost River: Desert Salmon Crossing
places.desc:
Somewhere beneath the dust of Black Rock City runs an invisible river.

The Black Rock Desert Salmon Bureau is building an emergency migration corridor for the rare and possibly imaginary Desert Ghost Salmon. A wooden path leads visitors across the missing river, over a small bridge, and through a landscape marked by traces of water, fish, vehicles, and an ecosystem struggling to exist.

Durin

places.name: Limen
places.desc: Limen is a sculptural installation centered on vertically oriented steel forms constructed from layered sheet metal. A patterned outer skin and perforated interior skin create shifting effects of surface, depth, and shadow. By day, the metal responds to changing light conditions; by night, internal illumination casts patterns into the surrounding space. Drawing on the visual languages of circuitry

places.name: Petaled Portal
places.desc:
Petaled Portal is Portal now petaled.  Possible of transformation to that which is here, brought to life through... C.R.E.A.T.I.V.I.T.Y.
Capturing
Reality
Endlessly
And 
Timelessly-
Idealized
Vitally
